utv.uk.description: The iconic TV series is back, but in a brand-new setting with brand-new prize boxes and a new batch of contestants hoping to win a whopping cash prize - who will have what it takes to beat our brand-new Banker? Now hosted by Stephen Mulhern, the series will see contestants battle it out against the notorious Banker to be in with a chance of winning a life-changing cash prize in a nail-biting game of nerves and intuition. Contestants are confronted with 22 sealed boxes with each one hiding a different amount of money - without knowing what each one contains, the contestant must eliminate the boxes, which are opened one at a time, and the amount of money inside is revealed. Pressure mounts as the player is tempted by the notorious Banker to accept an offer of cash in exchange for what might be inside their box, and as long as the larger cash prizes remain unchosen, the Banker's offers will get higher... but that can all change in an instant if a big cash prize is unveiled. utv.uk.title: Winter - Back to the Start
utv.uk.description: When a car crashes in woodland, the team discover the body of a young woman dressed in a strange old-fashioned gown. Winter quickly establishes that she died hours before the collision, turning what appears to be a tragic accident into something far more disturbing. Bell and Daldry trace the vehicle to a group of men on a stag do, but their accounts don't add up and it is clear they are concealing the truth. As Winter's examination reveals evidence that the victim endured years of captivity and abuse, the investigation becomes a desperate race to uncover her identity and the life she was forced to live. Pursuing every lead pushes Winter to take steps that put him directly in harm's way leaving the team in a frantic bid to save not only him but also another innocent life. Meanwhile, a major breakthrough in the Triangle case leads Winter and Bell to an unexpected location where they uncover evidence that could change everything they thought they knew. Captured on the police's body-worn camera, false accusations by the aggressor against Henry, alongside his pleas to police as he lay dying, caused national uproar. In an exclusive and deeply revealing interview with ITV's Paul Brand, Henry's family share memories of a much-loved son and brother whose life was cut tragically short, while asking searching questions about the treatment he received, and the police investigation that followed. It is also the story of a family's determination to uncover the truth, secure change and ensure that Henry is remembered not for his tragic murder but for the life he lived. (News) - 1999

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Escape to the Country
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S22 E15 Wye Valley The beautiful Wye Valley may not be too far from Bristol, where today's couple are from, but it's a whole world away in terms of lifestyle. Steve Brown has some tempting properties up his sleeve and during some downtime all three manage to unwind and enjoy the scenery with a leisurely canoe ride on the River Wye itself.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Bidding Room
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S8 E20 Batman Pinball Machine, Beatles-Style Money Box, Victorian Pill-Making Machine Nigel Havers and Simon Bower test their driving skills with a 1950s racing game, a collection of shining retro pieces go up for sale, and the dealers are intrigued by a curious Victorian contraption.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Bridge of Lies
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S4 E24 Quiz show hosted by Ross Kemp in which contestants compete for cash by crossing a bridge made up of stepping stones, each of which has a different option. Friends Ollie, Gus, Benjy and Joe must try to get from A to B by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies in order to cross the studio floor safely, or risk falling off the bridge and out of the game.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Pointless
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S30 E48 Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong, with Vick Hope.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: EastEnders
bbconemidlands.uk.description: E7434 12/11/2026 Linda vows to support Lee, Nancy finds herself asking Johnny for support, and Lauren gets overwhelmed by her feelings.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S19 E6 The remaining chefs compete in the quarter-final, beginning with an invention test in which they must use saffron to embellish their dish. The cooks then serve a two-course meal for three of the country's leading food writers and critics, Leyla Kazim, Xanthe Clay and David Ellis.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Shetland
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S11 E1 Calder and Tosh investigate when the skeletal remains of an unknown male are found inside a car dredged from water. It doesn't take long to establish that the victim was a respected local GP who fled the isles nine years ago, leading the detectives to establish what he was running from and why. Crime drama, starring Ashley Jensen and Alison O'Donnell.

bbconeni.uk.title: Money for Nothing - Episode 20
bbconeni.uk.description: Jacqui Joseph is in Buckinghamshire, determined to stop quality items being crushed at High Wycombe recycling centre. She sees potential in a drop-leaf table, a collection of canvas frames and a monk's bench, and enlists the help of upcycler Tristan Merriam and woodworker Martin Hough to try to bring them back to their best. Will Jacqui succeed in sending all three revamped items off to new homes?

bbconeni.uk.title: Escape to the Country - Wiltshire: Extended Versions
bbconeni.uk.description: The focus is firmly on Wiltshire today as Jonnie Irwin helps a couple from London with a £550k budget to make a life-changing rural move to this beautiful county. Jonnie also meets a group of bicycling enthusiasts.

bbconeni.uk.title: The Bidding Room - Furry Tables, Parachute Wedding Dress, Door Knockers
bbconeni.uk.description: Elaine is first through the doors, making friends wherever she goes. Will her miniature perfume bottles bring the sweet smell of success? Daniel tries to shift a pair of furry bedside tables, and Pixie shows off her parachute silk wedding dress.

bbconeni.uk.title: Bridge of Lies - Episode 23
bbconeni.uk.description: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four - in this episode, friends Jacqui, Harry, Annie and Andrew - take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer.

bbconeni.uk.title: Peelers: The PSNI for Real - Episode 1
bbconeni.uk.description: Dave and Owen bust a city centre drug dealer carrying cash and cocaine. The vehicle crime team chase a careless driver, and officers separating a street brawl face a torrent of abuse.

bbconeni.uk.title: Kill or be Killed
bbconeni.uk.description: At the Rafferty family's Sunday roast: it's more than the chicken that gets a roasting! Sunday roast means one thing: the whole family under one roof, and absolutely no chance of anyone getting through the meal without an argument. Ma Deirdre's up to high doh about her best frenemy Brenda, who's always finding out who died before her, but her problems are put on pause when the eldest daughter, Niamh, tries to manically pull everyone into her intermittent fasting quest.

bbconeni.uk.title: Splendid Mutation
bbconeni.uk.description: Nafisa has fled a war in Sudan that rages on. Camera in hand, she climbs a Belfast tower block still marked by the Troubles, racing the deadline for art college. Her mother's ghost leads her upward, towards Michael, a young man lost in his own grief. Two young people, two geographies, both raised inside a trauma that began before them. A splendid mutation begins.

bbconeni.uk.title: Jawbox
bbconeni.uk.description: In this high-stakes crime caper, bouncer Danny McQuaid is caught red-handed standing over the body of his murdered boss Frank. The only hope Danny has of proving his innocence is to work alongside combustible mother and daughter duo Mary and Charlie, private investigators at Jawbox Investigations. Can Danny convince Mary and Charlie that he didn't kill Frank? Can they all work together to catch the real culprit? And can they figure out why the last thing Frank said was Strudel?

bbconeni.uk.title: The MOBO Awards - MOBO at 30: Iconic Moments
bbconeni.uk.description: A celebration of 30 years of the MOBO organisation. A defining milestone for black British music and culture, this landmark anniversary looks at the history of the awards, its ambition, cultural impact and legacy, and features some of the awards' most iconic moments and memorable performances.

eden.uk.plus1.title: World at War - Morning
eden.uk.plus1.description: Interviews with Mountbatten himself, with Eisenhower's driver and with troops involved in the D-Day landings bring those gory and glorious days to life. (Documentary, War, History) - 1974

eden.uk.plus1.title: The World at War - Occupation
eden.uk.plus1.description: This unique documentary series covers an almost forgotten chapter of WWII: Holland's involvement. Occupation in 1940; repression; liberation in 1944. (Documentary, War, History) - 1974

eden.uk.plus1.title: World at War - Pincers
eden.uk.plus1.description: Paris is freed but celebrations are premature. As Montgomery's Arnhem raid and the Polish uprising fail badly, it seems five years in the war is still not at an end. (Documentary, War, History) - 1974

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys
eden.uk.plus1.description: In Belfast's grand Edwardian City Hall, Michael investigates the scene of a watershed moment in Irish history and hears how thousands of Ulster Protestants were mobilised by train to sign a document pledging opposition to Home Rule for Ireland. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys
eden.uk.plus1.description: Leaving from the seaport of Larne Michael reaches Stranraerand the Mull of Galloway, where in a lighthouse built by railway engineer, Robert Stevenson, he discovers a magnificent machine, installed at the turn of the 20th century. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo continues his journey through western Scotland by exploring the industrial heartland of Glasgow and its mighty River Clyde before taking the ferry to the island of Cumbrae. He is put to work behind the scenes at Glasgow's circular subway, explores the future of shipbuilding on the Clyde. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo falls into line with the University of Glasgow's Officer Training Corps. Founded in the early 20th century, the Corps flourishes today and Michael joins students for drill. From Glasgow, Michael heads west along the Firth of Clyde to Helensburgh, where he discovers a pioneering group of artists known as the Glasgow Boys. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Warwick to Radley
eden.uk.plus1.description: n Warwick's medieval castle he uncovers the scene of an extravagant and scandalous ball, which changed the life of its hostess, Daisy Greville, Countess of Warwick.At Cowley, Michael marvels at a spectacularly automated state-of-the-art production line producing 1,000 Minis a day and probes the pre-First World War origins of the Morris Oxford. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Reading to Taplow
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo picks up his rail journey from Warwick to Rye along the River Thames. In Reading, he traces the origins of education for workers. Messing about in boats is the name of the game in Henley on Thames, where Michael slips into a launch to hear about the world-famous regatta. Afternoon tea on the bank offers a chance to hear about four heroes of early 20th-century literary classic `The Wind in the Willows'. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys

(Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.description: Shopping from home.

eden.uk.plus1.title: Africa from Above - Zambia
eden.uk.plus1.description: An aerial adventure through the landlocked country of Zambia that takes in sights including the largest migration of mammals on Earth, the huge Victoria Falls, and the meandering Zambezi River.

eden.uk.plus1.title: Africa from Above - Mozambique
eden.uk.plus1.description: Explores the great diversity in natural landscapes and life in the country of Mozambique through visits to the country's Indian Ocean coastline, mountain rainforests, and Zembezi River delta. (Documentary, Nature) - 2022

eden.uk.plus1.title: Africa from Above - Cameroon
eden.uk.plus1.description: Journeys through the diverse landscapes, rich cultures and linguistic customs, and remarkable flora and fauna of Cameroon, a country that sits at the crossroads of West and Central Africa. (Documentary, Nature) - 2022

eden.uk.plus1.title: Africa from Above - Botswana
eden.uk.plus1.description: Explores the great variation in the landscapes of Botswana. Includes visits to the salt pans of the Makgadikgadi, the maze of marshlands and floodplains within the Okavango Delta, and the Kalahari Desert. (Documentary, Nature) - 2022

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Series 3 : Reno to Napa Valley
eden.uk.plus1.description: Beginning in the Silver State of Nevada, Michael takes to the skies over the dramatic Sierra Nevada mountain range. At Lake Tahoe, he hears of the first European explorer, known as `The Pathfinder', whose discovery opened up the west for settlement. Travelling on the historic Virginia and Truckee heritage line, Michael investigates the vast deposits of silver and gold ore on which Virginia City was built. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Series 3 : San Francisco
eden.uk.plus1.description: Armed with his trusty Appleton's Guide, Michael Portillo reaches San Francisco, where he boards one of the city's iconic cable cars. Behind the scenes in the engineering powerhouse, he uncovers the street cars' secret to scaling the city's famously steep hills. In the Presidio neighbourhood, a leading publisher introduces Michael to San Francisco's long tradition of fine printing and book-making. Michael takes the opportunity to have his own treasured book appraised. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Series 3 : Berkeley to Santa Cruz
eden.uk.plus1.description: Following his Appleton's guide, Michael Portillo makes a trip to the jewel in the crown of America's National Parks, Yosemite, to behold its towering granite cliffs, its giant sequoia trees and cascading waterfalls. He discovers how early conservationists fought to protect it in law and encounters a `buffalo soldier' in the heart of the forest. In Berkeley, Michael uncovers a catastrophic event, which hit the city of San Francisco hard in 1906. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Series 3 : Monterey to Los Angeles
eden.uk.plus1.description: Steered by his late 19th-century Appleton's guidebook, Michael Portillo continues through southern California aboard the Coast Starlight rail service. In the historic port of Monterey, Michael raises the Bear Flag of the one-time Republic of California and above it, the Stars and Stripes. He discovers the city's Spanish and Mexican heritage and traces how the former fishing port described as `stinking and decrepit' in John Steinbeck's novel, `Cannery Row', has become a beacon for tourists. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Series 3 : Los Angeles to San Diego
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo strikes oil in the suburbs of Los Angeles, contemplates his navel in the orange groves of Riverside, makes a California roll and paints a pretty picture in Laguna Beach. It is Mexican Independence Day and the locals are celebrating the country's hard-won independence from Spain in the early 19th century. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Boston to Concord
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo's nineteenth-century Appleton's guidebook leads him to the Parker House Hotel, where in his best pinny, he whisks up a Boston cream pie. In the fine dome atop Massachusetts General Hospital, where no-one could hear the screaming, Michael discovers the scene of grisly surgery, first made bearable, in 1846, by a miraculous new substance. North of Boston, in Salem, Michael is caught up in a witch hunt. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Series 3 : Plymouth to New London
eden.uk.plus1.description: Guided by his Appleton's and tracing the footsteps of the Pilgrim Fathers, Michael Portillo heads for Plymouth, the `home town' of America. He learns how indigenous tribes of Wamponoag people taught newly arrived settlers to live off the land, inspiring one of the biggest holidays in today's American calendar. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - New Haven to Plattsburgh: Reversion
eden.uk.plus1.description: Armed with his Appleton's guide, Michael Portillo continues his rail journey through Connecticut and New England. He takes a crash course in rowing in New Haven, where college teams from Yale and Harvard have battled for victory on the water since 1852. In Vermont, Michael visits a 19th-century farm, where the rich milk from prized Jersey cows imported from the British Isles supplied a thriving butter industry. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.description: Bentley Motors have been building bespoke cars for the rich and famous for almost a century, and for the first time in their long history, the doors of its historic home in northwest England have been opened to the cameras. (Documentary, Cars/motoring, Special) - 2017

together.uk.title: Sort Your Life Out - The Viney Family
together.uk.description: Stacey and her gang challenge the Viney family to sort their lives out by decluttering in just seven days. Not only did grandma of six Sue fill her house up with her late mum's belongings, she also acquired the contents of a recently closed gift shop. Daughters Nicki and Donna want to spend more time at the house with their kids, but all the clutter means there isn't any space. (Home improvement, House/garden) - 2023

together.uk.title: Clive Myrie's Italian Roadtrip - Barga
together.uk.description: Clive swerves Tuscany's famous posh villas to head to the mediaeval town of Barga, where over half the locals have Scottish connections. Staying in a mansion that's now a Glaswegian-run B&B, Clive finds out why Italians love a fish supper, finds himself cooking dinner for 14, and joins an expedition to discover the forgotten quartz quarry that helped make Tuscany's capital Florence so beautiful.

together.uk.title: Flipping Profit - Faversham
together.uk.description: Antiques auctioneer Catherine Southon, wheeler dealer Tony Wong and upholsterer extraordinaire Micaela Sharp head to Faversham to find some bargains they can turn into some flipping profit. Sure, they'll find some items in its antique shops, scrap yards and flea markets, but will they be able to flip them for a healthy profit.

amc.us.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
amc.us.description: Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes. (Comedy, Adventure) - 1995

amc.us.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
amc.us.description: When the dolphin mascot of Miami's NFL team is abducted, Ace Ventura, a zany private investigator who specializes in finding missing animals, looks into the case. Soon Miami Dolphins players are kidnapped too, including star player Dan Marino, making Ace's sleuth work even more pressing. Working with Dolphins representative Melissa Robinson, Ace closes in on the culprits, but not before many ridiculous misadventures. (Comedy) - 1994

amc.us.title: The Rundown
amc.us.description: Beck (The Rock) is a tight-lipped bounty hunter who doesn't like to use a gun and accepts any job without asking questions. When Beck's employer, Walker (William Lucking), sends him to the Amazon to locate Walker's cocky son, Travis (Seann William Scott), Beck discovers a population controlled by a tyrannical treasure hunter (Christopher Walken). To survive, Beck and Travis must work together, without their affections for a mysterious rebel (Rosario Dawson) getting in the way. (Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2003

amc.us.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
amc.us.description: Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an island where none should exist. Knowing that he will not be able to dissuade Sean from tracking the signal to its source, Hank, Sean's new stepfather, joins the teen on a quest to the South Pacific. Together with helicopter pilot Gabato and Gabato's feisty daughter, Kailani, they set out to find the island and rescue its sole human inhabitant. (Adventure, Fantasy, Action) - 2012

amc.us.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
amc.us.description: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever. (Adventure, Action, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemax.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

cinemax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: A scientist's quest to find a cure for Alzheimer's disease unintentionally results in a highly intelligent chimpanzee, which may signal the end of man's dominion over Earth. - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Trance
cinemax.us.description: A criminal (Vincent Cassel) hires a hypnotherapist (Rosario Dawson) to probe the mind of a brain-injured auctioneer (James McAvoy) to uncover the hiding place of a stolen painting. - 2013

cinemax.us.title: The Whistlers
cinemax.us.description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera. - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Shape of Water
cinemax.us.description: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank. - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Body at Brighton Rock
cinemax.us.description: A part-time state park employee faces her worst fears as she guards the site of a potential crime scene deep in the wilderness. - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemax.us.description: A Marine (Matthew Modine) and his companions (Adam Baldwin, Vincent D'Onofrio) endure basic training under a sadistic drill sergeant and fight in the 1968 Tet offensive. - 1987

cinemax.us.title: Extraction
cinemax.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. - 2015

cinemax.us.title: Judy
cinemax.us.description: Beloved actress and singer Judy Garland arrives in London to perform at the Talk of the Town nightclub in 1968. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband. - 2019

cinemax.us.title: My Blind Brother
cinemax.us.description: An overachieving, blind athlete (Adam Scott) and his slacker sibling (Nick Kroll) compete for the affection of the same woman (Jenny Slate). - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Happy Death Day
cinemax.us.description: A college student must relive the day of her murder over and over again, in a loop that will end only when she discovers her killer's identity. - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Super Troopers 2
cinemax.us.description: Former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption in Canada. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties and a smuggling ring. - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eight
cinemax.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Wedding Crashers
cinemax.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Romantic comedy) - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Grudge Match
cinemax.us.description: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all. (Comedy) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Scream
cinemax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: Man Down
cinemax.us.description: When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location. (Thriller, Drama) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: My Blind Brother
cinemax.us.description: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemax.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Shot Caller
cinemax.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Our Kind of Traitor
cinemax.us.description: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis). (Thriller) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: The Watchers
cinemax.us.description: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night. (Horror, Thriller) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Open Water
cinemax.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama, Horror) - 2003

cinemax.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
cinemax.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemax.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
cinemax.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. (Action, Thriller) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
cinemax.us.description: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home. (Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemaxaction.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemaxaction.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror, Movie, Mystery) - 2000-10-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemaxaction.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2016-09-11

cinemaxaction.us.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
cinemaxaction.us.description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. (Comedy, Fantasy, Horror, Movie) - 2024-08-28

cinemaxaction.us.title: It
cinemaxaction.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Movie, Mystery) - 1990

cinemaxaction.us.title: Scanners
cinemaxaction.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction, Thriller) - 1981-01-14

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1972-03-12

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Hedorah
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla fights pollution in the form of living sludge found by a scientist (Akira Yamauchi) and his son (Toshie Kimura). (Action, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1971-07-24

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1973-03-17

cinemaxaction.us.title: Mom and Dad Save the World
cinemaxaction.us.description: While planning to destroy Earth with a gigantic laser beam, Emperor Tod Spengo (Jon Lovitz), ruler of the planet Spengo, catches a glimpse of housewife Marge Nelson (Teri Garr) and becomes smitten with her. Beaming Marge and her husband, Dick (Jeffrey Jones), up to Spengo from California, the daft, dimwitted leader tries to woo her, and sends her spouse to prison. Soon Dick is plotting an insurgency, in hopes of overthrowing Spengo and rescuing his wife. (Action, Adventure, Children, Comedy, Family) - 1992

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemaxaction.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1995-08-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: Enter Nowhere
cinemaxaction.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (Drama, Horror, Movie, Mystery, Science Fiction) - 2011-10-22

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
cinemaxaction.us.description: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways. Soon, the full scope of Martin's intent becomes menacingly clear when he confronts Steven with a long-forgotten transgression that will shatter his domestic bliss forever. (Drama, Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2017-05-22

cinemaxaction.us.title: Solace
cinemaxaction.us.description: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer. (Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2015-09-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
cinemaxaction.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (Action, Adventure, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2023-06-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Atomic Blonde
cinemaxaction.us.description: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies. (Action, LGBTQ, Movie, Thriller) - 2017-07-28

cinemaxaction.us.title: Companion
cinemaxaction.us.description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire. (Dark comedy, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2025-01-10

cinemaxaction.us.title: Us
cinemaxaction.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2019-03-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Apparition
cinemaxaction.us.description: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2012-08-24

cinemaxaction.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
cinemaxaction.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2014-02-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: A Hard Day's Night
cinemaxaction.us.description: The Beatles in their feature film debut, one of the greatest rock-and-roll comedy adventures ever. The film has a fully restored negative and digitally restored soundtrack. The film takes on the just-left-of-reality style of mock-documentary, following "a day in the life" of John, Paul, George, and Ringo as fame takes them by storm. (Comedy, Movie, Music, Musical comedy) - 1964-07-06

cinemaxaction.us.title: Blood Simple
cinemaxaction.us.description: "Blood Simple" was the first feature film from Joel and Ethan Coen. This is the newly restored and re-edited director's cut of the film, introduced by Mortimer Young. The stylish crime thriller premiered at film festivals in 1984. "Blood Simple" begins deep in the heart of Texas, where a jealous saloon owner hires a cheap divorce detective to kill the saloon owner's younger wife and her bartender lover. But the detective gets a better idea: he follows the two lovers, and... (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1984-07-07

cinemaxaction.us.title: Isle of Dogs
cinemaxaction.us.description: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture. (Action, Adventure, Animated, Comedy, Drama) - 2018-02-15

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman
cinemaxaction.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself "The Joker" (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Crime, Fantasy, Movie) - 1989-06-23

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemaxaction.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 1992-06-19

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Forever
cinemaxaction.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Crime, Fantasy, Movie) - 1995-06-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman & Robin
cinemaxaction.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 1997-06-20

cinemaxaction.us.title: Joker
cinemaxaction.us.description: Forever alone in a crowd, failed comedian Arthur Fleck seeks connection as he walks the streets of Gotham City. Arthur wears two masks -- the one he paints for his day job as a clown, and the guise he projects in a futile attempt to feel like he's part of the world around him. Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2019-08-31

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason. (Holiday, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 1998-07-27

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Halloween: Resurrection
cinemaxclassics.us.description: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive. (Holiday, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2002-07-12

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages. (Holiday, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 1995-09-29

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Night on Earth
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach De Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Drama, Movie) - 1992-04-25

cinemaxclassics.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." (Thriller, Drama) - 2015

cinemaxwest.us.title: My Blind Brother
cinemaxwest.us.description: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

cinemaxwest.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemaxwest.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

cinemaxwest.us.title: Shot Caller
cinemaxwest.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2017

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Watchers

cinemaxwest.us.title: Open Water

cinemaxwest.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
cinemaxwest.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure) - 2023

cinemaxwest.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire

cinemaxwest.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
cinemaxwest.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). (Action, Thriller) - 2013

foodnetwork.us.title: Bobby Flay's the Line - Dale Talde: Goosefeather ᴺᵉʷ
foodnetwork.us.description: Time is not on their side when the clock gets the best of the chefs in a Cantonese cook-off between Bobby Flay's home team and Dale Talde's visiting line.

foodnetwork.us.title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas - The Holly Jolly Holiday Tournament Returns
foodnetwork.us.description: Fieri is back to host a holiday showdown in a Winner's Wonderland! All-new teams of 32 superstar chefs create sweet and savory delights in hopes of sleighing the competition, winning the title, scoring $100,000 and delivering big bucks for charity.

foodnetwork.us.title: Bobby's Triple Threat - Titans vs. An Iron Chef
foodnetwork.us.description: An OG Iron Chef is ready to show Bobby Flay's Titans who's boss; it's not this contender's first time in the TT kitchen, but this time, he brings his knives; Bobby's good friend and industry veteran Stephen Kalt decides who will be victorious.

foodnetwork.us.title: Bobby Flay's the Line - Dale Talde: Goosefeather
foodnetwork.us.description: Time is not on their side when the clock gets the best of the chefs in a Cantonese cook-off between Bobby Flay's home team and Dale Talde's visiting line.

foodnetwork.us.title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas - The Holly Jolly Holiday Tournament Returns
foodnetwork.us.description: Fieri is back to host a holiday showdown in a Winner's Wonderland! All-new teams of 32 superstar chefs create sweet and savory delights in hopes of sleighing the competition, winning the title, scoring $100,000 and delivering big bucks for charity.

foodnetwork.us.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Just Another Flay in The Office
foodnetwork.us.description: Chef Christian Petroni and actress Kate Flannery from "The Office" recruit chefs Josh Gale and Christian Ortiz for a hostile takeover of Bobby Flay's kitchen.

foodnetwork.us.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Bottoms Up, Bobby Down!
foodnetwork.us.description: Actress, comedian and foodie Aisha Tyler and Katie Lee Biegel get crafty.

foodnetwork.us.title: The Kitchen: World on a Plate
foodnetwork.us.description: We make delicious bites inspired by countries all over the world.

foodnetwork.us.title: The Kitchen - Friendsgiving Favorites
foodnetwork.us.description: Special guests Ted Allen, Christian Petroni and Martina McBride join the group for a Friendsgiving filled with Turkey Day favorites; sweet-and-spicy smoked turkey and smoked gravy; triple sec cranberry relish; fried Brussels sprouts.

foodnetwork.us.title: The Kitchen - Fall Festival Favorites
foodnetwork.us.description: The kitchen is making their favorite fall festival treats, including the ultimate pumpkin bread, honey-fried turkey legs with Japanese BBQ sauce and apple fritters with hot honey glaze; a game of Try or Deny features some unexpected fall flavors!

foodnetwork.us.title: Bobby's Triple Threat - Titans vs. Ashleigh Shanti
foodnetwork.us.description: Bobby Flay invites rising star Chef Ashleigh Shanti to face-off against the Titans; she keeps the Titans guessing with her unique mix of Appalachian and Southern cooking, while Chef Wylie Dufresne doles out his criticisms.

foodnetwork.us.title: Bobby's Triple Threat - Titans vs. Katsuji Tanabe
foodnetwork.us.description: Chef Katsuji Tanabe's bravado is as big as his desire to take down Bobby Flay's Titans; Katsuji is desperate for his first big win, and it's up to judge Judy Joo to decide if it's his turn for victory.

foodnetwork.us.title: Bobby's Triple Threat - Titans vs. Kaleena Bliss
foodnetwork.us.description: Chef Kaleena Bliss is on a competition winning streak; chef Kaleena is beaten Bobby Flay, and now he's invited her to try her luck at the Titans, while Bobby's protégé, Chef Hillary Sterling, dishes out tough critiques.

foodnetwork.us.title: Bobby's Triple Threat - Titans vs. Michael Jenkins
foodnetwork.us.description: The Titans think they're ready to go up against Alex Guarnaschelli's protégé, Chef Michael Jenkins; Michael has judged each of the Titans before and uses that knowledge to his advantage.

foodnetwork.us.title: Guy's Grocery Games - Best Noodles Ever
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri sends chefs running down aisles in this high-stakes competition.

foodnetwork.us.title: Guy's Grocery Games - Red, White, and Food
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri invites three GGG winners to celebrate America's 250th birthday with a cook-off. First, the chefs make a picnic plate with ingredients like apple pie and corn dogs. Then, a game of cornhole determines the ingredients for a grilled dinner.

foodnetwork.us.title: Guy's Grocery Games - GGG Winners' Holiday Extravaganza
foodnetwork.us.description: Four previous winners return for the holidays to take on more of Guy Fieri's games; chefs must shop for ingredients using nothing but oversized stockings; chefs are given a gingerbread house that they must flip into a fine dining holiday dinner.

foodnetwork.us.title: Guy's Grocery Games - Fieri Family Holiday Showdown
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's two sons and nephew face off; Guy pairs each family member with their very own all-star chef partner, but he also gives each team a Secret Santa box full of weird ingredients to use.

foodnetwork.us.title: Guy's Grocery Games - GGG Best Buddies Holiday Special
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri teams up some of his friends from the Best Buddies volunteer organization with some all-star chefs for a holiday cook-off; the teams have one hour to make a holiday entrée and dessert for a chance to earn $15,000 for their teammate.

foodnetwork.us.title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking - Memorable Firsts and Magic
foodnetwork.us.description: James and Oliver challenge the teams to create cakes inspired by the first Harry Potter movie and their favorite spells; the showpieces are delivered to the Quidditch pitch and Ollivander's Wand Shop for judging by Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain.

foodnetwork.us.title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking - The Chamber Challenge ᴺᵉʷ
foodnetwork.us.description: James and Oliver ask the baking teams to bring the Basilisk, Moaning Myrtle, a Howler and Hermione as a cat to life in their cakes; the showpieces are presented to judges Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain in the iconic Chamber of Secrets itself.

foodnetwork.us.title: Holiday Baking Championship - The Time of Your Life
foodnetwork.us.description: After a peppermint dessert preheat, Jesse Palmer asks the baking teams to make radical red velvet desserts in honor of Santa's fresh fit; Judges Duff Goldman, Kardea Brown and Molly Yeh choose the winner of the $1,000 prize package. (Reality, Cooking, Holiday) - 2026-11-09

foodnetwork.us.title: Chopped - Holiday Sweethearts

history.us.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Pearl Harbor

history.us.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Secrets and Lies

history.us.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Stalingrad
history.us.description: In Operation Blue, the German Army fights to take Soviet oil fields and the city of Stalingrad, becoming one of the deadliest battles ever fought and a major turning point on the Eastern Front.

mgmplus.us.description: Desperate for money to save his sick daughter, Ben Richards joins the top-rated show on television, "The Running Man," a deadly competition where contestants must survive 30 days while being hunted by professional assassins. - 2025

mgmplus.us.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
mgmplus.us.description: A robotic boy, the first programmed to love, David is adopted as a test case by a Cybertronics employee and his wife. Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David. Without final acceptance by humans or machines, David embarks on a journey to discover where he truly belongs, uncovering a world in which the line between robot and machine is both vast and profoundly thin. (Science fiction, Fantasy, Drama, Adventure, Thriller) - 2001

mgmplus.us.title: RoboCop
mgmplus.us.description: In a violent, near-apocalyptic Detroit, evil corporation Omni Consumer Products wins a contract from the city government to privatize the police force. To test their crime-eradicating cyborgs, the company leads street cop Alex Murphy (Peter Weller) into an armed confrontation with crime lord Boddicker (Kurtwood Smith) so they can use his body to support their untested RoboCop prototype. But when RoboCop learns of the company's nefarious plans, he turns on his masters. (Science fiction, Action) - 1987

mgmplus.us.title: Treasure Island - Chapter 5: Skeleton Island
mgmplus.us.description: On Skeleton Island, Jim leads the search for the treasure as tension and paranoia rise when the island's dark history emerges; jockeying for control, they finally reach the fortune—but an unexpected force intervenes before anyone can claim it. (Adventure) - 2026-11-08

mgmplus.us.description: After their escape, Luke and friends plot to end the Institute for good; the Director enlists a new ally; Sigsby seeks a way back in. (Thriller) - 2026-11-08

mgmplus.us.title: The Greatest Story Ever Told
mgmplus.us.description: From his birth in Bethlehem to his death and eventual resurrection, the life of Jesus Christ (Max von Sydow) is given the all-star treatment in this epic retelling. Major aspects of Christ's life are touched upon, including the execution of all the newborn males in Egypt by King Herod (Claude Rains) ; Christ's baptism by John the Baptist (Charlton Heston) ; and the betrayal by Judas after the Last Supper that eventually leads to Christ's crucifixion and miraculous return. (Holiday, Historical drama) - 1965

mgmplus.us.title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
mgmplus.us.description: When traveling con man Latigo Smith (James Garner) drifts into a small Western town, he decides to take advantage of a local rivalry between gold-mining factions. Recruiting the shifty Jug May (Jack Elam) to pose as a notorious gunfighter, Smith sets his scheme in motion, while also taking time to romance the lovely Patience Barton (Suzanne Pleshette). However, after his ruse is uncovered, Smith incurs the wrath of the real hired gun, among others, leading to a big shoot-out. (Western, Comedy) - 1971

mgmplus.us.title: Kingpin
mgmplus.us.description: Roy Munson (Woody Harrelson) is a young bowler with a promising career ahead of him until a disreputable colleague, Ernie McCracken (Bill Murray), tricks him into participating in a con game that ends with Roy's bowling hand crippled for life. Years later, Roy ekes out a hardscrabble existence until he discovers Amish bowling phenom Ishmael (Randy Quaid). With the help of a gangster's girlfriend (Vanessa Angel), he plots to take Ishmael to the top of the bowling world. (Comedy) - 1996

mgmplus.us.title: Overboard
mgmplus.us.description: Kate is a single, working-class mother of three who's hired to clean a luxury yacht that belongs to Leonardo -- a selfish, spoiled and wealthy Mexican playboy. After unjustly firing Kate, Leonardo falls off the boat and wakes up with no memory of who he is. To get payback, Kate shows up at the hospital and convinces the confused amnesiac that they're married. As Leonardo tries to get used to manual labor and his new family, Kate starts to wonder how long she can keep fooling her fake husband. (Romantic comedy) - 2018

mgmplus.us.title: Uptown Girls
mgmplus.us.description: Molly Gunn (Brittany Murphy) has never worked a day in her life and has lived like a queen since her father, a famous rock 'n' roll star, died and left her his fortune. But everything changes when Molly realizes that her manager has stolen her money. She lands a job as a nanny for Ray (Dakota Fanning), a young girl whose serious attitude is the opposite of Molly's carefree one. With help from her boyfriend, Neal (Jesse Spencer), Molly tries to bond with Ray and learn how to be an adult. (Comedy) - 2003

mgmplus.us.title: Some Kind of Wonderful
mgmplus.us.description: Keith Nelson (Eric Stoltz), an artsy high school outcast, tries to land a date with popular girl Amanda Jones (Lea Thompson) with some help from his tomboy best friend, Watts (Mary Stuart Masterson). However, his advances draw the ire of Amanda's snobby ex-boyfriend, Hardy Jenns (Craig Sheffer), who makes plans to get even. Matters are further complicated when Watts realizes she likes Keith as more than just a friend and tries to convince him to stop pursuing Amanda. (Romance, Drama) - 1987

mgmplus.us.title: Teen Wolf
mgmplus.us.description: When high school nerd Scott Howard (Michael J. Fox) learns from his father, Harold (James Hampton), that being a werewolf runs in the family, he decides to take advantage of his freakish trait. With his newfound strength and agility, Scott quickly becomes the hero of his school's basketball team while winning over longtime crush Pamela Wells (Lorie Griffin). As he grows more popular, Scott worries he is being celebrated as a novelty rather than for who he is. (Comedy, Fantasy) - 1985

mgmplus.us.title: The Longest Yard
mgmplus.us.description: An ex-football star doing time is forced by the warden to organize a team of inmates to play against his own line-up of guards. The warden tries to blackmail him into throwing the game, but the convicts have their own ideas and see the game as an opportunity to repay some of the brutality they have endured. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 1974

mgmplus.us.title: Varsity Blues
mgmplus.us.description: In West Canaan, Texas, high school football reigns supreme. When starting quarterback Lance Harbor (Paul Walker) turns up injured, the Coyotes' ruthless coach, Bud Kilmer (Jon Voight), must promote benchwarmer Jonathon "Mox" Moxon (James Van Der Beek) to lead the team in its quest for a divisional title. Suddenly thrown into the spotlight, Mox must deal with the pressure of carrying the aspirations of an entire town on his shoulders, as he struggles to pursue his own very different dreams. (Comedy drama, Romance, Action) - 1999

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Preacher's Wife
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A handsome angel (Denzel Washington) saves a New York Baptist preacher (Courtney Vance) and his wife (Whitney Houston) from spiritual doubt and marital woe. (Movies, Fantasy) - 1996

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Flashdance
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A Pittsburgh welder works days, dances in a bar at night, dates her boss and chases the dream of acceptance into a prestigious ballet school. (Movies, Drama) - 1983

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Almost Famous
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: An aspiring teenage rock journalist gets his big break when he follows an up-and-coming band on its tour. (Movies, Comedy Drama) - 2000

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Love Story

What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others. (Sports talk, Baseball) - 2009-01-01

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Hauler Back
motortrend.us.description: The wrecked shell of a 1970 Suburban car hauler tests Bill and his metal geniuses as they transform it into a high-end diesel, low, long bed, crew cab dually; Ekstensive makes a lifted and loaded F150 for Boots for Troops, a military charity.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Extra Large & Supercharged
motortrend.us.description: Bill pushes the shop's creativity with his own build of a 2018 Yukon Denali XL; the luxury SUV is their tallest build ever with a custom lift, straight axles and a supercharger; the '70 Suburban gets a custom chassis and body with a fourth door.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - International Truck of BBQ
motortrend.us.description: Bill and the guys are known for their custom metal work, but the transformation of a 1940 International Harvester water truck into a mobile barbecue pit tests all their skills; a 1986 C-10 is a family heirloom that's remade for future generations.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Hauler Back

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Extra Large & Supercharged

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - International Truck of BBQ
motortrend.us.description: Bill and the guys are known for their custom metal work, but the transformation of a 1940 International Harvester water truck into a mobile barbecue pit tests all their skills; a 1986 C-10 is a family heirloom that's remade for future generations.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - C10 to a Hundred
motortrend.us.description: Bill and the guys take a good C10 to a hundred with custom touches from inside to out including one of one interior and bed; Ekstensive makes a dream come true by modifying a 2018 Dodge Demon for an under ten-second quarter mile run on the track.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - The Grand Finale
motortrend.us.description: Bill and the team bring a wrecked '70 Suburban hauler back to life as a long bed, four door, crew cab dually with a 5.9 Cummins diesel engine, custom chassis and suspension; a '65 Plymouth Belvedere II gets some extra muscle with a Mopar crate Hemi.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Street Rod Milk Truck
motortrend.us.description: Rusty and riddled with bullet holes, Bill's neighbor hands over the crumbling shell of a '52 Ford F4 Milk Truck; the guys unleash their best fabrication skills and turn this 60-year-old milk truck into a one of a kind, dazzling diesel street rod.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - Hell of a Chevelle
motortrend.us.description: A 5-year-old girl offers up her piggy bank to help get her father's 1968 Chevelle finished; the Squad lets her keep her money but thinks twice about accepting the job when they see what this car needs to get back on the road.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - License to Cruise
motortrend.us.description: A 16-year-old gear head has big plans for his 1987 Land Cruiser; the Squad helps to get his truck in shape for an off-road race.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - Cutlass Comeback
motortrend.us.description: When tragedy struck a family, their black 1972 Oldsmobile Cutlass convertible just faded away in their garage, but The Squad does its best to help father and son move forward with their lives and their project.

motortrend.us.title: Junkyard Empire - Ready, Set, Tow!
motortrend.us.description: Andy puts the boys to work on a crazy-looking vintage race car, a Hot Wheels Ramblin' Wrecker tow truck racer, and a 1970 Chevrolet Camaro rescued from Hurricane Sandy.

motortrend.us.title: Junkyard Empire - Too Much Rough, Not Enough Diamond
motortrend.us.description: Andy has his doubts when his father, Bobby, is determined to fix up the ultimate junker; Bobby relies upon a few old-school tricks to prove his son wrong.

motortrend.us.title: Junkyard Empire - Turbos & Tailgates
motortrend.us.description: Andy transforms an old ambulance into a Maryland Sportsmobile for a fellow college alumnus, then thinks outside the box to soup up a vehicle for a buddy in blue.

motortrend.us.title: Truck Dynasty - Shaq's Super Truck
motortrend.us.description: NBA star Shaquille O'Neal shows up unannounced at Apocalypse, to Jerry Jr.'s delight - he's been trying to get Shaq's attention for over a year; Joe begins work on Shaq's Juggernaut, but Jerry repeatedly interferes, forcing Ashley to step in.

motortrend.us.title: Truck Dynasty - F*cking Broncos
motortrend.us.description: Pop's returning customer from Texas wants a Ford Bronco converted into a pickup truck that can tow a 7,000-pound boat and is still fit for off-roading; Jerry Jr. orders the shop to paint a truck in a vivid neon green to chase likes and shares online.

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Driving Miss Crazy
motortrend.us.description: The first of the Three Amigos builds is coming to a close -- a 1970 tribute Barracuda with a 392 crate Hemi! Mark and the team rush to complete the dash, the 392 Hemi, the A/C and the interior for the Barracuda's first road test in over 7 years.

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - High Impacts and Low Blows
motortrend.us.description: Mark demonstrates two different types of car collision, highlighting the often-overlooked secondary damage; Alyssa assists Doug with a particular rear axle.

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Could It Bee a 383?
motortrend.us.description: Mark needs Tony's help to solve a Mopar mystery; will the evidence give Mark the certainty he requires? When John from Phillips Racecraft arrives, the fate of Doug's nasty 440 engine is revealed.

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Mark Unmuted
motortrend.us.description: Mark Worman and his gang of garage ghouls work to bring some of the most wrecked muscle cars back to life.

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Mopar by Death
motortrend.us.description: Mark airs the entire "Mopar by Death" animated series!

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - This ZZ1 is Tops!

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - A Tale of Two Drop Tops
motortrend.us.description: Mark and Aaron show off two related and rare builds; digging into the Graveyard Carz archives, for the first time ever, they squeeze two complete car builds into one episode, a 1967 Hemi GTX convertible and a 1969 Hemi Road Runner convertible.

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Even White Carz Get the Blues
motortrend.us.description: A decade-long restoration comes full circle. This rare, two-tone, Hemi 'Cuda is finally complete and ready to go home, but not before Mark shows us why the Hemi is the King-Kong of the street! (Reality, Auto, How-to) - 2025-10-15

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - New TV

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Indoor Adventure

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Big Announcement

screenpixaction.us.description: Friends George Hansen (Robert Duvall) and Mike Locken (James Caan) are hit men who do contract jobs for a company called Com-Teg, associated with the CIA. But, when George gets a better offer from the competition, he turns on Mike, breaking his elbow and shoulder. It takes Mike a long time and a lot of physical therapy to get back on the job, but he does -- and coincidentally finds himself protecting a client whom Hansen and his gang are simultaneously being paid to assassinate. (Action) - 1975

screenpixaction.us.title: Foreign Intrigue
screenpixaction.us.description: After the sudden death of his millionaire boss, Dave Bishop (Robert Mitchum) begins a quest to discover the source of his mysterious employer's wealth. On a journey that will take Bishop across the European continent, life-threatening encounters lurk around every corner. As Bishop soon finds out, his boss acquired his wealth through underhanded schemes and blackmail. Now that their blackmailer is dead, those who are free want to keep Bishop from taking his place. (Drama) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: Pier 5, Havana
screenpixaction.us.description: Miami businessman Steve Daggett (Cameron Mitchell) arrives in Havana in the wake of the revolution, looking for his army buddy Hank (Logan Field), a hard-drinking mechanic who has suddenly vanished. Steve follows a trail that leads him to the apartment of his old flame -- Hank's current wife, Monica (Allison Hayes) -- and to a boat shop where he is beaten up by strangers and warned to leave Cuba. He discovers that Hank's disappearance is linked to a conspiracy to depose Fidel Castro. (Adventure) - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: Attack!
screenpixaction.us.description: Lt. Joe Costa (Jack Palance) is a part of Fragile Fox Company, a National Guard unit sent to a Belgian town in the final stages of World War II. Costa harbors some serious doubts about the leadership abilities of Captain Cooney (Eddie Albert), a coward who only secured his position because of his ties to Lt. Col. Bartlett (Lee Marvin). Cooney's inexperience and his open contempt for Costa threaten the lives of his men as they draw closer to Battle of the Bulge. (War, Drama) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: Alexander the Great
screenpixaction.us.description: The son of Philip of Macedonia (Fredric March) and Olympias (Danielle Darrieux), Alexander the Great (Richard Burton) is one of the most legendary leaders throughout history. As the Macedonian king, Alexander successfully unites all the ancient Greek tribes and leads them to defeat the imposing Persian Empire. With the fall of Babylon, Alexander continues to conquer most of the known world. Eventually, he achieves the status of unparalleled ruler atop his newly formed Greek empire. (Historical drama) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: Billion Dollar Brain
screenpixaction.us.description: Harry Palmer (Michael Caine) is a former British secret agent who has taken up work as a private detective. An anonymous party hires him to deliver a seemingly normal package to Helsinki. However, he learns that he has been deceived into working for the Secret Service again, and is actually returning stolen virus-infected eggs to a government lab. Palmer is then persuaded to thwart a manic Texas oil baron (Ed Begley) who is planning to attack the Soviet Union with a supercomputer. (Drama) - 1967

Learning he has only weeks to live, Lucca meets with Lloyd Ward (George Dzundza) -- the man he has long been convinced is the murderer, but never had enough evidence to arrest -- intending to force a confession. But nothing prepares them for what happens next. (Horror, Thriller) - 2010

Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues. (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2009

showtimewomen.us.title: The Cured

With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life. (Romantic comedy) - 2001

showtimewomen.us.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason

On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue. Whittaker's charm, wisdom and sense of humor help him develop a special bond and growing friendship with Jules. (Comedy drama) - 2015

(Comedy drama, Romance) - 2009

showtimewomen.us.title: Serendipity

(Romantic comedy) - 1989

As news of the showdown spreads like wildfire, poor Andy desperately seeks any way out of his date with certain doom. (Comedy) - 2017

As the polar opposites start to collide, Tanya soon discovers that her sibling's picture-perfect life may not be what it seems. (Romantic comedy) - 2018

shoxbetwest.us.title: Burn Mother...ker, Burn!
shoxbetwest.us.description: A chronicle of how decades of troubled relations between the LAPD and the African-American community served as the prelude to the 1992 Los Angeles uprising. (Documentary) - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: Star Trek: Section 31
shoxbetwest.us.description: Emperor Philippa Georgiou faces the sins of her past after joining a secret division of Starfleet that's tasked with protecting the United Federation of Planets. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action) - 2025

shoxbetwest.us.title: American Dream/American Knightmare

shoxbetwest.us.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Now

However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Yogi Bear
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie
