buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

cbsphiladelphia.us.title: Beyond the Gates
cbsphiladelphia.us.description: "Beyond the Gates" is set in a leafy Maryland suburb just outside of Washington D.C., and in one the most affluent African American counties in the United States. At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. But behind these pristine walls and lush, manicured gardens are juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered. And those that live outside these gates are watching closely. These are the places where the characters live, love, work and play. Those who have "made it" and those who haven't are all trying to navigate life -- and some with more grace than others. (Soap)

cinesony.us.description: Un espacio único que reúne los detrás de cámaras de las películas de acción más relevantes de Hollywood. (Performing Arts)

cinesony.us.title: Take Shelter
cinesony.us.description: Un hombre de Ohio intenta desesperadamente proteger a su familia después de que unas visiones aterradoras lo convencen de que un desastre apocalíptico se cierne sobre ellos. (Movies, Drama) - 2011

cinesony.us.title: Retreat
cinesony.us.description: En una isla aislada, el intento de una pareja para recuperarse de una tragedia personal es destrozado cuando un desconocido les informa de una enfermedad aérea que está arrasando con Europa. (Movies, Thriller) - 2011

cinesony.us.title: Moon
cinesony.us.description: El astronauta Sam Bell vive aislado durante tres años en una excavación minera lunar. Poco antes de que llegue el reemplazo, mientras sufre dolores de cabeza y alucinaciones, Sam descubre la presencia de una versión más joven de sí mismo. (Movies, Sci-Fi) - 2009

cinesony.us.title: The Caller
cinesony.us.description: Una mujer divorciada y con problemas se convierte en el objeto de una terrible venganza cuando intenta eliminar una serie de misteriosas llamadas telefónicas. (Movies, Mystery) - 2011

cinesony.us.title: Untraceable
cinesony.us.description: Dos agentes del FBI intentan encontrar a un astuto asesino en serie que publica videos en vivo de sus sangrientos crímenes en Internet. (Movies, Thriller) - 2008

cinesony.us.title: Cold Comes the Night
cinesony.us.description: Un criminal que está sufriendo una rápida pérdida de visión decide raptar a la propietaria de un hotel y a su joven hija. Las necesita para que sean sus ojos y poder recuperar un maletín de dinero que está en manos de un peligroso policía corrupto. (Movies, Thriller) - 2013

cinevault.us.title: Legion
cinevault.us.description: For the patrons and staff at a dusty roadside diner, the day begins as usual, but when the phones go out and a sweet old lady goes on the attack, it's a harbinger of the terror to come. As the horrifying nature of the situation sinks in, help arrives in the form of the archangel Michael (Paul Bettany), who tells a pregnant waitress that her unborn baby is humanity's last hope, and he will do anything to protect it. (Fantasy, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2010-01-22

cinevault.us.title: Anaconda
cinevault.us.description: Filmmaker Terri Flores (Jennifer Lopez) is traveling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist (Eric Stoltz) and a cameraman (Ice Cube), come across Paul (Jon Voight), who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behavior puts everyone on edge. They realize too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune -- if they can catch it. (Movie, Thriller) - 1997-07-11

cinevault.us.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
cinevault.us.description: Bill Johnson leads a group of scientists into the jungles of Borneo. They are searching for the mythical black orchid, which can supposedly grant eternal life. Unfortunately, massive anacondas have been feeding on the orchids for years. When their boat goes over a waterfall, the scientists land right in the middle of the snakes' home. (Action, Adventure, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2004-08-27

cinevault.us.title: The Princess and the Marine
cinevault.us.description: A Marine has a forbidden romance with a Muslim Bahraini princess and sneaks her to the United States to marry her. (Drama, Movie) - 2001-02-18

cinevault.us.title: Wings of Courage
cinevault.us.description: The film tells the dramatic story of three legendary French aviators and the first historic airmail flights in the Andes. It combines a tale of high adventure and excitement with cutting-edge technology, and is the fulfillment of one of Annaud's long-held dreams. (Adventure, Movie) - 1995

cinevault.us.title: Birdy
cinevault.us.description: Birdy returns from the Vietnam War scarred from the horrific experiences of battle. He is so damaged by what he saw that he has shut himself off from reality completely, imagining that he is actually a bird. Birdy is confined to a mental hospital, where the doctors are at a loss as to how to treat him. In an attempt to help, Al, his best friend from high school -- and who was also in Vietnam -- visits him every day to try and get through to him. (Drama, Movie) - 1984-12-14

cinevault.us.title: The Marine 6: Close Quarters
cinevault.us.description: Jake Carter and another former Marine, Luke Trapper, join forces to rescue a kidnapped girl from a gang of international criminals. (Action, Movie) - 2018

cinevault.us.title: The Beast
cinevault.us.description: A Soviet tank unit led by Commander Daskal (George Dzundza) destroys a village in Afghanistan in 1981. Taj (Steven Bauer), a member of the village, vows revenge and pursues him, along with the mujahideen. Meanwhile, the radical Daskal turns violent against his unit when he murders the tank crewman (Erick Avari) for his Afghan ethnicity and leaves tank driver Koverchenko (Jason Patric) to be killed by the mujahideen. Taj, however, offers Koverchenko sanctuary for his assistance against the unit. (Movie, War) - 1988-09-14

cinevault.us.title: Company of Heroes
cinevault.us.description: During World War II, a group of American soldiers heads to the heart of Nazi Germany to find a scientist who developed a devastating weapon for Hitler and now wants to defect. (Action, Movie, War) - 2013-02-26

cinevault.us.title: Ike: Countdown to D-Day
cinevault.us.description: Gen. Dwight D. Eisenhower (Tom Selleck) faces monumental decisions in the 90 days leading to the Allied invasion of Normandy in 1944. (Historical drama, Movie) - 2004-05-31

cinevault.us.title: Sahara
cinevault.us.description: An Army sergeant (James Belushi), his crew (Mark Lee, Paul Empson) and stragglers try to hold off a Nazi battalion at a Libyan waterhole. (Movie, War) - 1995-04-25

cinevault.us.title: Hero
cinevault.us.description: Serial swindler Bernie Laplante (Dustin Hoffman) makes the first selfless gesture of his life when he helps save injured passengers from a roadside plane crash and then vanishes into the night. Hoping to find the hero who pulled her out of the wreck, reporter Gale Gayley (Geena Davis) announces a $1 million prize for stepping forward. But when handsome vagrant John Bubber (Andy Garcia) takes credit, Bernie struggles to expose him amid a media circus and countless adoring fans. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1992-10-02

cinevault.us.title: 28 Days
cinevault.us.description: The story of Gwen Cummings (Sandra Bullock), a successful New York writer living in the fast lane and everyone's favorite party girl -- until she gets drunk with boyfriend Jasper (Dominic West), borrows her sister's (Elizabeth Perkins) wedding limo and earns herself a stay in court-ordered rehab. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 2000-02-08

cinevault.us.title: Random Hearts
cinevault.us.description: After a plane crash in which both their spouses are killed, Sergeant Dutch Van Den Broeck and Congresswoman Kay Chandler's lives are connected. Their spouses were headed to the same address, with identical keys, under Mr. and Mrs. plane tickets. The investigation leads to startling discoveries and an unexpected romance. (Drama, Movie) - 1999-10-08

cinevault.us.title: The River Murders
cinevault.us.description: A homicide detective investigating a series of murders becomes the prime suspect when the FBI uncovers his close ties to all the victims. (Movie, Thriller) - 2011-07-01

cinevault.us.title: Maximum Risk

Alain then uncovers a web of family secrets that lead him to New York City, where his brother was involved with the Russian Mafia. Teaming up with Mikhail's lover, Alex Minetti, Alain must now assume his twin's identity and go undercover to avenge Mikhail's death. (Action, Movie) - 1996

The duo even picks up a Marilyn Monroe impersonator, Ashley, during the surreal pilgrimage to Graceland. (Drama, Movie) - 1998

cinevault.us.title: Nothing in Common

eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E02 Big Flappy Bastards Charlie doesn't know how to discipline Jake for luring a flock of seagulls into his room; Judith surprises Alan when he goes home to fix her sprinklers.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E03 Go East on Sunset Until You Reach the Gates of Hell One drink too many emboldens the brothers to stand up to their controlling mother.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E04 If I Can't Write My Chocolate Song, I'm Going to Take a Nap Alan offers to help get Charlie's cleaning lady back if Charlie can get Jake ready to go out to dinner with his mother.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E05 The Last Thing You Want Is to Wind Up With a Hump Charlie and Alan meet several women while attending one of Jake's soccer games.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E06 Did You Check With the Captain of the Flying Monkeys? After Evelyn's new beau dumps her, Charlie and Alan enlist Jake to cheer her up; Charlie teaches Jake a lesson about screening telephone calls from women.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E07 If They Do Go Either Way, They're Usually Fake For a school assignment, Jake draws the tattooed buttocks of Charlie's female friend.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E08 Twenty-Five Little Pre-Pubers Without a Snoot-Ful Charlie realizes Jake's classmates know the words to all of his jingles, and he is inspired to craft the fourth-grade musical with unusual results.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E09 Phase One, Complete Jake and Evelyn befriend one of Charlie's one-night stands, causing her to stay longer than expected.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E10 Merry Thanksgiving In an attempt to prove that he is a family man, Charlie invites Lisa (Denise Richards) over for Thanksgiving dinner.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E11 Alan Harper, Frontier Chiropractor Alan reluctantly agrees to a makeover after running into his ex-wife and her new beau; when the brothers go shopping, they clash over what to buy.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E12 Camel Filters and Pheremones The housekeeper's beautiful granddaughter comes to work with her and attracts the attention of the men; Alan tries to convince Judith that Charlie's house is good for Jake.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E13 Sarah Like Puny Alan Charlie sets his ailing brother up on a date, then drags him to a steam room to help him get rid of his flu symptoms.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E14 I Can't Afford Hyenas Charlie realizes he's broke when his credit card is declined at the grocery store. Richard Lewis guest stars.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E15 Round One to the Hot Crazy Chick Against Alan's judgment, Charlie falls for a seemingly crazy woman named Frankie. Guest star: Jenna Elfman.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E16 That Was Saliva, Alan Frankie tells Charlie and Alan why she and her daughter are on the run; Frankie's daughter has a crush on Jake.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E17 Ate the Hamburgers, Wearing the Hats Alan offends Charlie by choosing harebrained cousins as Jake's guardians in the event of his death.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E18 An Old Flame With a New Wick Charlie is stunned to learn his ex-girlfriend is now a man (Chris O'Donnell).

McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American. (Action, Comedy) - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: Survivor
filmriseaction.us.description: Framed for a terrorist bombing, a foreign service officer (Milla Jovovich) must dodge a top assassin (Pierce Brosnan), while racing against time to thwart a deadly plot. (Action, Thriller) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: In Hell
filmriseaction.us.description: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity. (Action) - 2003

filmriseaction.us.title: Stolen
filmriseaction.us.description: A former thief (Nicolas Cage) has just 12 hours to come up with $10 million after his former partner (Josh Lucas) kidnaps his daughter and locks her in a cab. (Action, Thriller) - 2012

filmriseaction.us.title: If... Dog... Rabbit
filmriseaction.us.description: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother. (Drama) - 1998

filmriseaction.us.title: The Gunman
filmriseaction.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief. (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Crime drama, Romance) - 2008

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gang of Roses

They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E02 Viking Long Ship Gefjon Take a river tour through some of Europe's greatest cities--Budapest, Vienna, and Amsterdam--on Viking Longship Gefjon.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E01 Paul Gauguin The Paul Gauguin offers five-star luxury while sailing near the coral reefs, mountainous islands and tropical playgrounds of French Polynesia.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Planes
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E01 Boeing 747-8F Transporting the gear of Formula E's 10 electric-powered racing teams to cities around the world across more than 50,000 total kilometers in the greenest way imaginable is no easy task; for air transport, DHL uses Boeing 747 or 777 aircraft.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Trains
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E01 Glacier Express The Glacier Express features cutting-edge technology to pull the train up the steepest slopes on its route across the Swiss Alps.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E02 Royal Clipper Royal Clipper is the largest sailing cruise ship in the world, celebrating tall ships of the 19th century while offering modern-day service for its guests.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E01 Seven Seas Explorer Sailing from Chile and Peru to Ecuador and Costa Rica, the luxurious Seven Seas Explorer cruise ship is full of marble, granite and almost 500 chandeliers.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Trains
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E04 Indian Pacific The Indian Pacific is a four-day, 4,352-kilometer transcontinental journey across Australia, a trip which features the world's longest straight stretch of railway and steepest incline.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Trains
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E06 Frecciarossa 1000 And Italo EVO Go behind the scenes with NTV's two Italo trains - the AGV and the EVO - as they expand to cover more of the Italian railway network, connecting passengers from Turin to Venice, and Naples to Milan, on two of the world's fastest trains.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E02 AIDAnova We hop aboard a seven-day cruise to the Canary Islands and Madeira aboard the first large liner to run purely on cleaner-burning liquefied natural gas.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E05 Stella Australis The only cruise ship designed specifically to navigate the treasures and dangers at the southern tip of South America.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E03 MSC Regal Princess Follow mega cruiser Regal Princess as she whisks guests to Germany, Russia, and Scandinavia in style.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E03 Azamara Journey Azamara Journey travels the rivers of Southeast Asia, delivering passengers to exotic cities and hidden treasures that larger cruise ships cannot reach.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E02 Earthquakes & Exoskeletons Milwaukee commissions Calatrava to design a museum with 90-ton wings that take flight; Oslo tears down its national ski jump and rebuilds it for the World Championships; and in LA, a 235-foot tower is wrapped in steel bands.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E01 Reborn Buildings & Sacred Grounds In Oklahoma, a sacred spiral mound rises on a former oilfield, honouring 39 tribes; London's crumbling Battersea Power Station is reborn with two million new bricks. And in Spain, Frank Gehry crowns a historic winery.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E05 Canals & Curves Witness amazing buildings, bridges, lifts, and other structures that pushed structural concrete engineering to the edge.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E08 Wings & Waterlines Lord Foster's five-winged steel towers cool Abu Dhabi's national museum naturally; Robots 3D-print a steel bridge in Amsterdam & a concrete tower in Switzerland; and in Sydney, engineers pump out the harbour to build a fish market.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E09 Space Homes & Glass Waves NASA's 3D-printed Mars habitat rehearses human life on the red planet. Seoul's historic city hall gains a 13-story glass wave. And in Dallas, 68,000 square feet of concrete galleries balance on legs that want to splay open under.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E01 Riverparks & Artworks Traveling to New York, Denver and Nice, France to visit Little Island, the Denver Museum of Art and La Tête Carrée; the secrets to how they were built are revealed.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E05 Ecobuilds & Earthquakes Witness amazing buildings, bridges, lifts, and other structures that pushed structural concrete engineering to the edge.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E02 Towers & Roofs A Manhattan high-rise; an Athens cultural center; a Singapore university.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E03 Euro Hauler Following a million-dollar freight run across four European countries and meeting the drivers, engineers and maintenance teams who keep the train running.

classica.us.title: Die drei Leben der Clara Schumann
classica.us.description: Die Biografie von Clara Schumann ist legendenumwoben: Ihre strenge Kindheit, ihr außergewöhnliches Talent als Pianistin, ihre frühe Liebe zum Komponisten Robert Schumann und die Erziehung von sieben Kindern bieten Material für Mythen und Klischees.

classica.us.title: Kammermusik von Mozart und Schostakowitsch
classica.us.description: Der Geiger Renaud Capuçon tritt beim Festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly auf und spielt Kammermusik aus dem klassischen Repertoire und dem Repertoire des 20. Jahrhunderts. Er tritt mit den Solisten der Internationalen Menuhin-Musikakademie auf.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op.12
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung vom Verbier Festival von 2018 zollt Seong-Jin Cho Claude Debussy Tribut anlässlich seines 100. Geburtstags. Auf dem Programm stehen Schumanns Fantasiestücke op. 12, die nur selten in Konzertprogrammen zu hören sind.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Bach - Goldberg-Variationen, BWV 988
classica.us.description: Der italienische Pianist Andrea Bacchetti spielt 2015 im Theater Carlo Felice in Genua Bachs Goldberg-Variationen, BWV 988. Das Werk ist nach dem Cembalisten Johann Gottlieb Goldberg benannt, der möglicherweise der erste Interpret des Werkes war.

classica.us.title: Sol Gabetta auf dem Lucerne Festival 2018
classica.us.description: Die argentinische Cellistin Sol Gabetta kehrte 2018 zum Lucerne Festival zurück, um gemeinsam mit dem Mahler Chamber Orchestra unter der Leitung des Dirigenten François-Xavier Roth ein Konzert zu geben.

classica.us.title: Sinding - Serenade in A-Dur, Op. 92
classica.us.description: Francesca Dego und Domenico Nordio sowie Andrea Bacchetti spielen die Serenade in A-Dur, Op. 92 des norwegischen Komponisten Christian Sinding. Diese Aufführung wurde am 2. Dezember 2013 im Teatro Comunale Città di Vicenza, Italien, aufgenommen.

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Mariss Jansons
classica.us.description: Mariss Jansons probt mit dem Oslo Philharmonischen Orchester die kraftvolle Suite aus Béla Bartóks Pantomimenballett "Der wunderbare Mandarin", gefolgt von einer Aufführung des gleichen Stücks aus dem Konzerthaus von Oslo.

classica.us.title: Schubert -- Rondo D. 951
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmete sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich der Kammermusik. Auf dem Programm standen unter anderem Felix Mendelssohns Klaviertrio Nr. 1 in d-Moll, Op. 49 und Franz Schuberts Rondo in A-Dur, D. 951.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: In the Organ's Stomach
classica.us.description: Olivier Latry, der aktuelle Titularorganist der großen Orgel von Notre-Dame, führt die Zuschauer mit seinem Instrument auf eine Reise durch Landschaften, die Geschichte und unglaubliche Abenteuer, deren Zeuge das Instrument war.

classica.us.title: Chopin - Introduktion und Polonaise, Op. 3
classica.us.description: Die Cellistin Silvia Chiesa und der Pianist Maurizio Baglini spielen Frédéric Chopins Introduction und Polonaise brillante in C-Dur, Op. 3. Das Konzert wurde 2024 im Sala Verdi des Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Mailand aufgenommen.

classica.us.title: Mahler - Sinfonie Nr. 1 in D-Dur, 'Titan'
classica.us.description: Das Maggio Musicale Fiorentino ist das älteste Opernfestival Italiens. Der Maestro Daniel Harding übernimmt das Dirigieren in einem wunderbaren Konzertprogramm mit der tragischen Ouvertüre in d-Moll, Op. 81 von Johannes Brahms.

classica.us.title: Werke von Gluck, Bach und Mozart
classica.us.description: Der in Venezuela geborene Dirigent Giovanni Guzzo leitet durch dieses 2024 in Madrid aufgezeichnete Konzert. Es standen Werke von Christoph Willibald Gluck, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart und Johann Sebastian Bach auf dem Programm.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Letzte Sonate Op. 109, 110 & 111
classica.us.description: Seine drei letzten Sonaten widmet Beethoven den intimen Dynamiken der menschlichen Seele, die von Verzweiflung bis Verwandlung reichen. Im Film werden die Musikwerke mit Szenen in verlassenen Schlössern untermalt, die an Einsamkeit erinnern.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 9 in d-Moll, op. 125
classica.us.description: Das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris unter Leitung von Philippe Jordan interpretiert die neunte Symphonie von Ludwig van Beethoven. Die Solisten sind Ricarda Merbeth, Daniela Sindram, Robert Dean Smith und Günther Groissböck.

classica.us.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
classica.us.description: Die Mezzosopranistin Magdalena Kožená und der Tenor Andrew Staples schließen sich Sir Simon Rattle an, um den Zyklus "Das Lied von der Erde" von Gustav Mahler zu Gehör zu bringen. Das Konzert fand am 9. Mai 2021 im Barbican Centre in London statt.

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 7
classica.us.description: Ungewöhnliche Orchesterfarben und -effekte. Die Verwendung seltenerer Instrumente und die frischen Klanglandschaften, die Mahler schafft, führen zu einem reichen und einzigartigen Hörerlebnis.

classica.us.title: Grieg - Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Dirigent Jan Latham-Koenig leitet das Flanders Symphony Orchestra mit einer Aufführung von Edvard Griegs Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16. Diese Aufführung wurde am 21. April 2016 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Rachmaninow und Gershwin: Rhapsodies
classica.us.description: Das National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia unter der Leitung von Dirigent Konstantin Kwatinets präsentiert Werke von Rachmaninow und George Gershwin. Der gefeierte russische Pianist Boris Berezowski ist ebenfalls mit von der Partie.

classica.us.title: Werke von Bach, Bartók und Brahms
classica.us.description: Iván Fischer führt sein Budapest Festival Orchester mit Werken von Johann Sebastian Bach, Béla Bartók und Johannes Brahms. Die Aufführung wurde am 4. Dezember 2017 in der Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Verdi - Nabucco
classica.us.description: Das Orchester der Arena di Verona interpretiert Giuseppe Verdis dritte Oper „Nabucco" unter der Leitung des israelischen Dirigenten Daniel Oren. Das erfolgreiche Werk feierte seine Uraufführung im Jahr 1842 im Teatro alla Scala in Mailand.

classica.us.title: Martinů - Concertino für Klaviertrio & orchester
classica.us.description: Das italienisch-schweizerische Ensemble Trio des Alpen und das Orchestra da Camera di Mantova führen das Concertino für Klaviertrio und Streichorchester von Bohuslav Martinů auf. Diese Aufführung wurde 2016 im Teatro Bibiena in Mantua aufgenommen.

classica.us.title: Tschaikowsky - Lenskis Arie aus Eugen Onegin
classica.us.description: Verschiedene Stars der klassischen Musik nehmen am Benefizkonzert zugunsten des Erasmus-Fonds für "Intensivmed. Forschung" teil. Das Konzert wurde im Königlichen Konservatorium von Brüssel in Belgien am 21. Oktober 2023 aufgenommen.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation
tinyhousenation.us.description: S05 E11 A Texas-Sized Tiny Ashley and Angel want to move into a tiny house in their backyard; building a tiny home where the not-so-tiny Texas couple can stretch out and get comfortable pushes Zack's ingenuity to new heights.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation
tinyhousenation.us.description: S03 E20 230 Sq. Ft. Travel Well House Allen and Alexa are looking for a space that combines their love for fitness and travel while still having all the creature comforts of home and then some.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation
tinyhousenation.us.description: S03 E26 The 12 Zack Hacks of Christmas John and Zack recount 12 of their favorite Zack Hacks, and share some fun and festive DIY holiday projects.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E02 A Big Family Goes Tiny in the Shenandoah Valley Brian and Sarah want to leave behind all the work that goes along with having a 4,000-square-foot home so they can spend more time with their three young boys.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E03 Tiny Vacation Sanctuary in Northwest Washington Greg, Heather and their two kids, all big-time outdoor enthusiasts, want a tiny getaway home where they can unwind, unplug, explore and enjoy each other's company.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E04 Testing Out Tiny in Texas Newlyweds Britt and Travis have a passion for travel, but they still need a home base so they're hoping to find a low maintenance tiny home that has all the creature comforts they crave.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E05 An Expanding Family Downsizes in Austin Austin is the city for Sarah and Albert, but their high mortgage payments need to go, so they're on the hunt for a budget friendly tiny Texas home.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E06 A Tiny New Orleans Collaboration Reggie is an engineer in Seattle with a passion for music looking for a tiny home in New Orleans.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E07 A Tiny Trailblazer in Omaha Rebecca, an adventurous go-getter, hunts for a tiny home in Omaha, Neb., to help simplify her busy life; after working in finance in New York and London, she launches her own company and looks to plant roots back in her hometown.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E08 Tiny Living Big Sky Country Susan, Darryl and son Cooper balance their time between the outdoor life they love in Montana and sailing on their boat in Mexico; in order to continue enjoying the best of both worlds the family needs to spend less by going Tiny in Polson.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E09 Twin City Twosome Going Tiny Calvin and Brandon are recent college graduates in Minneapolis, they know a tiny home will help them economize, but differing opinions on mobile vs. a permanent home might derail their tiny plans.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E10 Going Tiny in Tampa Bay Tampa Bay area couple Joel and Kelly want to cut costs by going tiny, so Kelly can stay at home with their 8-year-old daughter Lola.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E11 Going Tiny Family Style in Omaha Jeff and Melany have three young daughters, and a determination to go tiny and live sustainably in Omaha, Nebraska.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E12 Texas Techies Go Tiny Jaimie and Mike live together in a large Austin condo with their many pets; they both get on board with Mike's dream to launch his own tech start-up, and to fund it, they agree to sell their condo and commit to a tiny lifestyle.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E13 A Tiny Couple's Retreat in Louisville Charles and Myra are looking for a tiny pied-à-terre in the heart of Louisville that can serve as their weekend getaway when they're not with the kids and as a crash pad for Charles when he works late and doesn't want to make the long commute home.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E14 A Boulder Tiny Lifestyle Mexican-born Hayde and her boyfriend Don are buying a tiny home together in downtown Boulder.

truehistory.us.title: The American Civil War - The Crisis at Fort Sumter
truehistory.us.description: From February through April 1861, the United States and the Confederacy eye each other warily and vie for the support of eight slave states; as various compromise proposals fall short, Fort Sumter in Charleston Harbor becomes a flashpoint.

truehistory.us.title: The American Civil War - The Opposing Sides, I
truehistory.us.description: Many think that the South is fated to lose; learning when the Confederate States of America came closest to winning; as fighting begins, each side has important advantages.

truehistory.us.title: The American Civil War - The Opposing Sides, II
truehistory.us.description: Learning whether the Confederacy has better generals and which side has the edge in strategic and political leadership; the attitudes of England and France; studying the side which marshals its resources and exploits its advantages more effectively.

truehistory.us.title: The American Civil War - The Common Soldier
truehistory.us.description: Learning why the young men join the colors of the North or the South; understanding what makes them bear the war's awful dangers and hardships; uncovering what it is like to be a soldier in the ranks.

truehistory.us.title: The American Civil War - First Manassas or Bull Run
truehistory.us.description: Following the Upper South's secession and the move of the Confederate capital to Richmond, Virginia, both sides gear up for war; learning the details of General Winfield Scott's Anaconda Plan and the factors that lead to the Battle of First Manassas.

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields - The Power of Place: The Civil War in Context
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the significance of battlefields and the methods employed by soldiers in combat.

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields - Manassas: The First Battle of Bull Run
truehistory.us.description: Marching from Washington, Irvin McDowell's Union forces encounter P. G. T. Beauregard's Confederate troops at Virginia's Bull Run.

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields - The Seven Days' Battles
truehistory.us.description: Robert E. Lee's Army of Northern Virginia and George B. McClellan's Army of the Potomac write a blood-soaked chapter in American history and alter the trajectory of the Civil War.

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields - A Return to Manassas: The Second Battle of Bull Run
truehistory.us.description: In the Second Battle of Bull Run, lieutenants James Longstreet and Thomas Stonewall Jackson play a crucial role in securing victory for Robert E. Lee.

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields - Antietam: America's Bloodiest Day
truehistory.us.description: The diverse terrains hinder troop formations and make the soldiers vulnerable to attacks during the Antietam battle. This results in intense fighting and many casualties.

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields - After Antietam: Photography and Medicine
truehistory.us.description: The war photographers provide an up-close look at the devastation caused during the Antietam battle. Compassionate medics like Clara Barton go down in history as heroes.

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields - The Battle of Fredericksburg
truehistory.us.description: The politically driven decision to replace McClellan with Burnside leads the Union soldiers to their doom in Fredericksburg.

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields - The Battle of Chancellorsville
truehistory.us.description: Victory comes at a heavy price for Robert E. Lee in the Battle of Chancellorsville after he employs some arguably high-risk battle strategies.

truehistory.us.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe - Andrée de Jongh and the Resistance
truehistory.us.description: When the Germans begin their rapid invasions across Europe, many ordinary citizens are stunned; Dedee de Jongh, a 23-year-old nurse, builds an escape line through Belgium and France to rescue stranded British airmen; her courage and ingenuity.

truehistory.us.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe - The Tory Rebels Who Helped Save England
truehistory.us.description: In hindsight, it may appear inevitable that Winston Churchill takes command; at the time, it seems unthinkable that Neville Chamberlain steps down; how a few brave politicians orchestrate one of the most striking political transitions in history.

truehistory.us.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe - Victor de Laveleye and V for Victory
truehistory.us.description: As an Olympic athlete, Victor de Laveleye is not an ordinary man; there is no reason to think he comes up with one of the war's most popular symbols, helping to buoy spirits and wage psychological warfare; the story of the V for Victory campaign.

truehistory.us.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe - Wilhelmina and Haakon: Royalty Fight Back
truehistory.us.description: When the Germans invade the Netherlands and Norway, Adolf Hitler wants to secure the leadership of these nations; the wrenching decisions and harrowing escapes of Queen Wilhelmina and King Haakon; how these royal figures fight the war from Britain.

truehistory.us.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe - Polish Pilots and the Battle of Britain
truehistory.us.description: The RAF's air battle to defend Britain from Germany in 1940; few people know that roughly 20 percent of the RAF consists of non-British pilots; witnessing the courage and successful maneuvers of Polish fighter pilots who save the day.

truehistory.us.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe - Wendell Willkie: \"A Godsend to This Country\"
truehistory.us.description: It might seem impossible to find a politician willing to sabotage his own campaign; that is exactly what Wendell Willkie does in his 1940 run against President Roosevelt: why he goes against his own party and supports FDR's plans to help Britain.

truehistory.us.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe - The Earl of Suffolk and Heavy Water
truehistory.us.description: Charles Henry George Howard, the 20th Earl of Suffolk, is an Englishman who seems unlikely to be responsible for the future of the free world; how he smuggles French scientists to England; how he foils Nazi efforts to obtain a nuclear bomb.

truehistory.us.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe - Marie-Madeleine Fourcade: Spymaster
truehistory.us.description: For years, the history books suggest there are no women leaders of the Resistance in France; the story of Marie-Madeleine Fourcade blows this theory out of the water; meeting this extraordinary woman; how she leads a spy ring throughout France.

truehistory.us.title: The Vietnam War - America Enters the War
truehistory.us.description: U.S. Marines arrive in June 1965 to protect a U.S. air base; the North Vietnamese Army and the southern Viet Cong guerrillas launch attacks.

truehistory.us.title: The Vietnam War - French Indochina and the Viet Minh
truehistory.us.description: Surveying the economic exploitation and repression that defines Vietnam in the 19th and early 20th centuries.

truehistory.us.title: The Vietnam War - Dien Bien Phu and Vietnam Divided, 1953-1959
truehistory.us.description: Examining mid-century Vietnam from the First Indochina War to the October 1955 referendum.

truehistory.us.title: The Vietnam War - Five Leaders Who Defined the Vietnam War
truehistory.us.description: Explore the makings of war in Vietnam through five major players, starting with Vietnamese leaders Hồ Chí Minh and Lê Duẩn in the north and Ngo Dinh Diem in the south.

truehistory.us.title: The Vietnam War - The Rise of the Viet Cong, 1959-1962
truehistory.us.description: Examining why the northern Vietnamese government decided to wage guerilla war in the south, and how it's adversaries responded.

truehistory.us.title: The Vietnam War - South Vietnam in Crisis, 1963
truehistory.us.description: In 1963, South Vietnam careens toward crisis; exploring the ARVN's deficiencies from lackluster military commanders to political legitimacy.

truehistory.us.title: The Vietnam War - The Gulf of Tonkin and a Crossroads, 1964
truehistory.us.description: Examining how the specter of communism in neighboring Indonesia shaped calculations made by the United States.

truehistory.us.title: The Vietnam War - The Vietnam War in the Skies
truehistory.us.description: While the United States boasts an impressive air force, its air campaign struggles when confronted by VC forces.

truehistory.us.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents - America: Forged in War
truehistory.us.description: Exploring The French and Indian War of the mid-1700s, which is one of the formative conflicts in American military history; focusing on the experiences of Lt. Col. George Washington, a young colonial officer fighting for the British.

truehistory.us.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents - George Washington Takes Command
truehistory.us.description: When the colonies begin their struggle for independence, they choose George Washington to lead the army; Washington's defense of Boston; his defeat trying to hold New York City; contrasting British and American objectives in the Revolutionary War.

truehistory.us.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents - Redcoats Fall to the Continental Army
truehistory.us.description: Washington's army is in dire straits; his command is in question; he revives his reputation with the famous crossing of the Delaware River; the next four years of the American Revolution, which see Britain's strategic advantage deteriorate.

truehistory.us.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents - Andrew Jackson and the War of 1812
truehistory.us.description: Why the United States chooses to fight Britain in the War of 1812; America's grievances and ambitions, which include the conquest of Canada; the poor strategy, command and training that lead to a strategic stalemate; the exception is Andrew Jackson.

truehistory.us.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents - The Mexican-American War of 1846-1848
truehistory.us.description: The continental U.S. reaches its present span due to the Mexican-American War; the strategies and tactics of generals Zachary Taylor and Winfield Scott; what disciplined and bold maneuvers conducted by a professional army can accomplish.

truehistory.us.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents - Opening Volleys of the Civil War: 1861-1862
truehistory.us.description: The Civil War sets the pattern for warfare in the 20th and 21st centuries; the political events leading up to the war; the strategy devised by Winfield Scott; the chaotic First Battle of Bull Run; developments in the western theater.

truehistory.us.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents - The Civil War's Main Front: 1862
truehistory.us.description: The ebb and flow of battle in the eastern theater; President Lincoln promotes and fires top commanders; The South faces instability in its top ranks until Robert E. Lee becomes the Rebel army's leader; following events through the Battle of Antietam.

truehistory.us.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents - Vicksburg to Gettysburg: 1862-1863
truehistory.us.description: In the summer of 1863, the Civil War reaches a climax on two fronts; studying the generalship of Grant in isolating and defeating the Confederate force defending Vicksburg; dissecting Gen. George Meade's tactics that halt Lee's invasion of the North.

truehistory.us.title: The Real History of Pirates - What is a Pirate?
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the reasons piracy endures from ancient times until today; why it is so difficult to both define and eradicate; how one can understand the rule of law and the rights of nations and individuals on the high seas and in borderless realms.

truehistory.us.title: The Real History of Pirates - Pirate Facts and Fictions
truehistory.us.description: Examining popular pirate legends; discovering which aspects include some truth and which contain none at all; pirate literature can teach a lot about the Jolly Roger, gold-filled treasure chests, the pirate Edward Thatch and more.

truehistory.us.title: The Real History of Pirates - Real Pirates of the Caribbean
truehistory.us.description: How the Spanish's power hold on the Caribbean is broken; which nationalities join in the free-for-all; the historical importance of Alexander Exquemelin's "Buccaneers of America" and Captain Charles Johnson's "A General History of the Pyrates".

truehistory.us.title: The Real History of Pirates - Pirate Attacks and Tactics
truehistory.us.description: Pirates want money or anything they can turn into money; consequently, they usually wish for a speedy surrender, do not want a battle and rarely sink captured ships; the many tactics pirates use to apprehend their prey in the age of sails.

unxplainedzone.us.description: S06 E08 Unbreakable Codes There's nothing more fascinating than a code that can't be cracked.

unxplainedzone.us.description: S06 E10 Monsters Among Us Since the dawn of humanity, tales of monstrous creatures lurking in the shadows have sparked both fascination and fear; discussing the potential that these stories have elements of reality to them.

unxplainedzone.us.description: S06 E07 Strange Technology There are many puzzling artifacts from around the world that challenge everything known about the technological capabilities of distant ancestors; some ancient objects are so mysterious they've spawned endless debate and theories.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S02 E10 The Search for Atlantis According to the Greek philosopher Plato, the lost continent of Atlantis was once home to an advanced civilization before it was destroyed in a cataclysm; for centuries, archaeologists have tried to uncover evidence to prove that this legend is true.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S02 E11 Extraordinary Engineering For centuries, humanity has been compelled to build remarkable structures that are much more than simple places of shelter or work.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S04 E10 Mysteries of the Missing Link More than 7 billion people live on Earth; human civilizations span the globe; although many around the globe believe that the divine hand of God placed humans on Earth, others question whether there were ever other kinds of human-like creatures.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S04 E08 Uncanny Curses All over the world, there are places and objects that are thought to be cursed; many people avoid these locations and things, believing they will bring harm, while others think that curses are nothing more than superstition and folklore.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S05 E05 The Power of Prophecy A look at the visions of mystics, prophets and clairvoyants throughout history, what their prophecies reveal and predictions for the future.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained

People say it walks on two legs, has the body of a man and the head of a wolf. They call it... the Dogman. In this episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle dives into one of the most talked-about cryptids.

waypointtv.us.title: Wilderness Chronicles
waypointtv.us.description: Wilderness Chronicles - Killer Croc's Warning The True Story Of Brett Mann In 2003, Brett Mann and two friends were stranded in the flooded wilds of northern Australia. When Brett swam for help, he was taken by a massive crocodile. But the true horror came next. For nearly 24 hours, the crocodile returned again.

waypointtv.us.title: Wilderness Chronicles
waypointtv.us.description: Wilderness Chronicles - Are Dinosaurs Still Alive In The African Congo? Could dinosaurs still walk the Earth? Deep in the Congo, legends say yes. In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green investigates the chilling reports of Mokele-mbembe, a dinosaur-like creature said.

waypointtv.us.title: The Green Way Outdoors : The Everglades Python
waypointtv.us.description: Kyle and Jeff embark on a 20-day mission into the Everglades to find the invasive pythons that are plaguing the ecosystem.

waypointtv.us.title: The Green Way Outdoors : Oklahoma Catfish Noodling
waypointtv.us.description: Kyle and Jeff get bit by catfish in Southern Oklahoma while using the most primitive fishing tactic, hand fishing.

waypointtv.us.title: The Journey Within
waypointtv.us.description: The Journey Within - 2022 Kentucky Whitetail Velvet Opener Mark Peterson and Earl Peterson are headed down to Kentucky for the opening of deer season. With this being the earliest that a bowhunter can hunt whitetails, it can result in a giant velvet whitetail harvest.

waypointtv.us.title: The Journey Within : The Journey Within - Giant Kentucky Velvet Whitetails
waypointtv.us.description: About 2–3 months ago Mark purchased a 300+ acre farm in Kentucky. After running trail cameras and putting food plots on the farm, Mark now has the chance to get in the stand on opening day of Kentucky's bow season.

waypointtv.us.title: The Journey Within : The Stag
waypointtv.us.description: A Bird Hunter's Diary is Mark Peterson's quest to hunt and harvest the 43 different species of waterfowl; this quest takes him into three different countries, 8 states, and includes over 110 days in the field, all in one season.

waypointtv.us.title: The Bearded Buck : Third Times A Charm
waypointtv.us.description: Illinois is one of those coveted midwestern states that every whitetail hunter dreams of hunting. In this episode, Jerry and Austin make their way to this buck paradise to hunt with our friends Jack Ficarra and Dylan Thomsen at 5 Seasons Outfitters.

waypointtv.us.title: American Heroes Outdoors : Hurricane Ian Aftermath with the Sanibel Fire Department
waypointtv.us.description: S09 E09 Connecting with the Sanibel Fire Department in Southwest Florida to highlight the devastation left behind from Hurricane Ian; honoring the next Scheels hometown hero, Rod Wilson.

waypointtv.us.title: American Heroes Outdoors : Beastmode Archery Challenge
waypointtv.us.description: S08 E05 Meeting Chris Hamm from HHA USA and HHA Sports in south central Wisconsin where his crew has organized a weekend, including the Beastmode archery challenge; Scheels Hometown Hero Timothy Haugen.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Domingo Martinez
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E07 U.S. Army veteran Domingo Martinez recounts overcoming the life-altering effects of his childhood trauma.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Shay Williams
waypointtv.us.description: U.S. Coast Guard helicopter pilot Shay Williams recounts his career flying countless search and rescue missions.

waypointtv.us.title: The WoodHaven Way
waypointtv.us.description: The WoodHaven Way - Passing Down The Tradition Hunting isn't about the size of the buck, it's about something much bigger; Jeff Lindsey of The Lindsey Way gets to experience one of the most special moments a father and hunter can ask for, introducing his kids to the outdoors.

waypointtv.us.title: The WoodHaven Way
waypointtv.us.description: The WoodHaven Way - A Deer Camp Tradition For Mike Pentecost and his son Jacob, Illinois deer camp has become a tradition they look forward to every single year. It's a place filled with memories, time spent together, and a shared love for chasing whitetails.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Kristina Hoyer
waypointtv.us.description: S04 E01 In a predominantly male profession, U.S. Navy veteran Kristina Hoyer recounts her incredible challenges while becoming a Navy rescue swimmer.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Danay & Lucas DePierre
waypointtv.us.description: S04 E02 Watch as Danay and Lucas DePierre, an Army and Air Force husband and wife, recount how the military shaped them into the people and parents they are today.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Dr. David Tharp and Scott Meador
waypointtv.us.description: S04 E03 Operation Healing Heroes documents the lives of our U.S. military heroes one soldier at a time.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Justin Klemm
waypointtv.us.description: S04 E04 U.S. Army National Guard veteran Justin Klemm recalls his time in service -- leading troops while dealing with his secret life of addiction.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Tom & Mary Henke
waypointtv.us.description: S04 E05 Watch as husband and wife Army veterans Tom and Mary Henke each recount their time serving during the Vietnam War.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Dave Allen: Part Two
waypointtv.us.description: S04 E06 Army veteran Dave Allen helps Paul Teutul Sr. from Orange County Choppers build a one-of-a-kind motorcycle to be revealed at the second annual Salute to American Heroes.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Frank Harris
waypointtv.us.description: S04 E07 A courageous Vietnam rescue mission leaves pilot Frank Harris with decades of PTSD and survivor's guilt.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Dave Bray
waypointtv.us.description: S04 E08 U.S. Marine Corps veteran and musician Dave Bray USA tells of his time in service and how music continues to shape his and his family's lives.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Eddie Jaramillo
waypointtv.us.description: S04 E09 U.S. Marine Corps veteran Eddie Jaramillo speaks about his life of continued service as he and host Jay Garstecki get tattoos from one of the country's premier tattoo artists.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Allie Dwyer
waypointtv.us.description: S04 E11 It's an honor no one wants -- a Gold Star Family is the immediate family member(s) of a fallen soldier who died while serving in a time of conflict. Allie Dwyer honors the memory of her husband, American hero Stephen Dwyer.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Jon Turnbull
waypointtv.us.description: S04 E12 After a suicide bomber detonated his vest, U.S. Army veteran Major Jonathan Turnbull flatlined three times and was given a 0% chance of survival. Watch as Jon and his wife, Samantha, share the story of his miraculous journey toward survival.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Dave Allen
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E01 Motorcycle junkie and Army veteran Dave Allen recounts the terrifying prospect of facing chemical warfare during Operation Desert Storm with host Jay Garstecki and guest Paul Sr. from American Choppers.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : John Arroyo
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E02 Shot through the neck at Fort Hood in Texas, U.S. Special Forces Green Beret Captain John Arroyo recounts coming face-to-face with his attacker and Jesus blinding his would-be killer.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Ginger Gilbert-Ravella
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E03 Ginger Gilbert-Ravella honors the memory of her husband, Major Troy Gilbert, a USAF Pilot and American hero.

waypointtv.us.title: The WoodHaven Way
waypointtv.us.description: The WoodHaven Way - Lopsided Larry Three years of patience came down to one perfect evening. Alex Rahman with Prime Ridge Outdoors has watched a buck he calls Lopsided Larry for the past three seasons, patiently waiting and giving the deer time to reach his full potential.

waypointtv.us.title: Wildbound by Forloh

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In July 1997, a triple murder terrified residents in the nation's capital. In a Georgetown coffee shop, three employees were shot to death. Investigators could find no immediate suspects and no clear motive for the attack. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong, or an act of cold-blooded vengeance against one of the victims?

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1986, a small crime free Indiana town was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. After an officer was gunned down at point-blank range, the psychotic killer led investigators across the Midwest. No one knew where the gunman would strike next, even as his tally of murders and abductions grew. The FBI and state police raced against time to rescue America's heartland from this deranged gunman, before he killed again.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Langley, Virginia, a gunman fired into rush hour traffic. The brazen daytime shooting of employees from the Central Intelligence Agency stunned the country. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political. The FBI was called in, but the nationwide search quickly became a far-reaching international manhunt. Agents processed more than 2000 leads and crossed an ocean in the effort to deliver justice.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her 10 year-old son was missing from his school. No one knew how it could have happened. Within hours, the boy's entire family was frantically searching for him. The few leads in the case quickly turned cold and the FBI was called in to aid in the investigation. The search by agents and local authorities would cover a thousand miles to expose the kidnapper and find the missing child.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On a summer afternoon in upscale Lodi, California, a 12-year-old girl is abducted from her home. Scores of police officers and FBI agents converge, determined to find the young girl before it is too late. When the kidnapper's car is discovered in a field near Lodi, police dogs, helicopters, and hundreds of volunteers are employed in a round-the-clock search. It would take a community united in concern for one of their youngest to find the missing child.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In rural Texas, 13-year-old is kidnapped on her way to school. Frantic to find her safely, her millionaire father calls local authorities and the FBI. As police officers and agents conduct aerial surveillance, the father drives hundreds of miles through the night to deliver the ransom cash to a drop that the kidnappers keep changing. In a final effort to save the young girl, investigators must engage in a dangerous firefight with five desperate criminals.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In September 1997, a team of masked gunmen robbed an armored car facility in Los Angeles, and made off with $18.9 million, the largest takeover heist in U.S. history. An employee believed she recognized the voice of one of the robbers, and FBI agents began conducting surveillance on a former employee of the facility. With only one piece of physical evidence, a fragment of a vehicle taillight, authorities hoped to connect him to the crime, and locate his accomplices.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In July 1996, two men entered a pawnshop in Birmingham, Alabama, and ruthlessly murdered the employees. Unbeknownst to the killers, a secret video surveillance camera recorded the shooting. Local police and the FBI released images of the crime to the media, and were quickly able to identify the perpetrators. Now authorities had to find two cold-blooded killers who knew that they were being pursued for murder one.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Lincoln County, Nebraska, a fugitive drug dealer engaged in a shootout with state troopers, wounding two of them, and eluded capture after a high-speed chase. Authorities immediately set up a statewide manhunt, connecting the fugitive to a murder in western Nebraska. A chance sighting led FBI agents to a second confrontation with the killer, who was more determined than ever to escape the law.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: After a career criminal committed a vehicular homicide in New Orleans, FBI agents tracked him through his habits and addictions. They focused their investigation on gambling communities throughout the country and, when he resurfaced in Atlantic City, authorities used all of their resources to trap an elusive sociopath who claimed that he would never be taken alive.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 1980's, a pair of serial bank robbers gained a reputation among law enforcement officials as formidable bandits. Using the same modus operandi, the two men took hostages and emptied bank vaults across the Midwest. After the criminals escaped from police custody, FBI agents familiar with the bandits believed that they would attempt a grand-scale heist. By conducting surveillance on known associates of the criminals, authorities tried to anticipate the next target.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the summer of 1999, Texas was terrorized by a brutal serial killer who traveled by train. The FBI assembled a task force to gather information about the dangerous drifter and create a profile that would help locate him. As they learned that the killer had traveled extensively through the United States and Mexico, the murders became more frequent, and authorities had to cast a dragnet over an entire continent in an effort to catch him.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On October 2, 1987, a Boston police officer responding to a domestic disturbance call was fatally wounded. Local authorities launched a citywide manhunt, but were only able to find the fingerprints of the chief suspect. Believing that he had fled the area, the FBI followed the suspect's trail to the west coast and then across the Mexican border, always aware of the desperation of a cop killer and of the need for justice.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In August 1984, the son of a successful real estate developer was kidnapped in front of his father's business in Miami. After the father received a $3 million ransom demand from a self-proclaimed terrorist, the FBI became involved. Based on witness descriptions of the car used in the kidnapping, authorities began to suspect a pair of Colombian nationals with a known grudge against the developer's family.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In October 1995, a South Carolina family was taken hostage as part of an elaborately planned bank robbery. Local police quickly identified two of the perpetrators, but the criminal mastermind proved more elusive. After his escape from custody, authorities began to suspect the fugitive of involvement in a series of bank robberies up and down the east coast, and the FBI remained on his trail, hoping to catch him before he took more hostages.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In February 1988, a record store clerk in Sandusky, Ohio, was fatally shot in his van. After discovering a night deposit bag with thousands of dollars in the vehicle, police knew that robbery was not the motive, and began to investigate other possibilities. FBI agents learned that several motorcycle gang members had been stopped nearby on a traffic violation shortly after the murder and theorized that the clerk's murder may have been a botched hit carried out by a gang member.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In June 1973, a young girl was abducted from a state park on the Missouri River while camping with her family. Several months passed with no leads, then an FBI agent took a particular interest in the case. Using a new technique known as criminal profiling, he predicted that the kidnapper would contact the girl's family on the one-year anniversary of her abduction. When this prediction came true, the FBI agent noted behavioral clues, hoping that they could lead him to the kidnapper.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1996, a group of political extremists twice robbed a bank in Spokane, Washington, using homemade bombs and military precision to escape. The FBI learned that the robbers, part of a shadowy organization called the Phineas Priesthood, might be preparing for a small-scale war with law enforcement. After the suspects were identified, the FBI was faced with the task of safely arresting a group of terrorists with a deadly agenda.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In August 1992, a man returned to his Memphis home and discovered that his wife was missing. The husband, as well as his friends, family and neighbors began to receive ransom calls. FBI agents noticed that one neighbor seemed to have the best rapport with the kidnapper. They began to question his level of involvement, but had to proceed carefully, knowing that he could be their only link to the missing woman.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1990 and 1991, Chicago police and the FBI were on the trail of a bank robber whose holdups were becoming increasingly violent. The criminal consistently used stolen Japanese cars to carry out the robberies, so authorities hoped to identify him by tracking vehicle thefts. When they finally located the man known as the bearded bandit, they learned that he did not work alone and he had made a pact never to surrender.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1988, new light was shed on the mysterious death of a South Carolina farmer when a criminal confessed that two prominent community members hired him to commit murder. Local police and FBI agents arrested a wealthy businessman and later learned that, even behind bars, he commanded the power to corrupt and kill. Using prison informants, agents had to prevent him from murdering again.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In October 1993, a robber surprised unsuspecting customers by dropping through the roof of a California bank. When police arrived, he escaped from the roof in a hail of bullets. A tip from a local resident led police and FBI agents to the perpetrator. They would soon learn that he had masterminded a local kidnapping, and held the fate of an innocent woman in his hands.

700407.description: Adam Frost adds tall plants for shady conditions to his borders, demonstrates how to make a window box for growing vegetables and herbs, and gives his tips on how to grow plants successfully in peat-free compost.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty catches up with all his summer jobs in the border and the vegetable garden. Carol gets inspiration for planting combinations at Cothay Manor and Gardens, and Arit learns about slugs and snails.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: At Longmeadow, Monty gives a masterclass on the summer pruning of fruit, gives advice on maintaining ponds and plants up a pot to give colour and interest to last into the autumn months. Adam Frost travels to Brodsworth Hall in South Yorkshire to meet a head gardener who has been set the challenge of restoring the gardens to their 19th century glory.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across Central Spain. He begins at the vast, imposing palace and garden of the Escorial before heading for Madrid, Toledo, other parts of Castile and finally Valencia.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don is in the south of Spain, visiting gardens that show how this part of the country has evolved thanks to influences from visitors and settlers from ancient to modern times.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don travels across northern Spain, visiting gardens across this vast and diverse landscape that changes from an Atlantic to a Mediterranean climate as he journeys from Galicia to Catalonia.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty and the team celebrate the wonder of trees and explore the vital role they play in gardens and the wider landscape. Zoe Ball joins Toby Buckland on a visit to a tree project in North London.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don is at Longmeadow with a host of seasonal jobs to keep his autumn garden looking beautiful for as long as possible, and in the third of her fascinating films about how plants work, Carol Klein investigates the science of stems.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty is preparing for spring colour as well as harvesting pumpkins and squashes. Carol Klein visits comedian Joe Lycett at home, and together, they plant up a container packed with layers of colourful bulbs. Toby Buckland visits Sue Kent's garden near Swansea to help out with autumnal maintenance.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty Don is asked to rescue two nightmare outside spaces. In Salisbury, newly engaged Glenn and Zoe want a brand new garden and most of all they are desperate to produce flowers for their wedding. Currently their steeply sloping garden is completely unusable.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty Don is asked to rescue two nightmare outside spaces. In Salisbury, newly engaged Glenn and Zoe want a brand new garden and most of all they are desperate to produce flowers for their wedding. Currently their steeply sloping garden is completely unusable.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty Don is asked to rescue two nightmare outside spaces. In Salisbury, newly engaged Glenn and Zoe want a brand new garden and most of all they are desperate to produce flowers for their wedding. Currently their steeply sloping garden is completely unusable.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don travels from the north west coast of Scotland to the north east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

724209.description: A quadriplegic woman loved by her community is found dead in an Orlando park 150ft from her motorized wheelchair. Children find her lifeless body face down in the sand.

724209.description: Jerra Kirby, who's visiting family in Orlando, has suddenly passed out at a theme park wave pool and the paramedics are trying desperately to revive her.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Chris Schaffer has not been seen or heard from in five days. Finally, his friends find him dead and decomposed in the driver's seat of his van.

724209.description: Ricky Hawthorne, a middle-aged man with a history of AIDS, arrives at his local hospital complaining of chest pains. Doctors perform extensive tests on him but find nothing wrong and release him.

724209.description: Police are driving down the street when a man suddenly jumps in front of their car. They screech to a halt and avoid hitting him, but the man is highly agitated.

724209.description: Teenagers stumble across a horrifying car fire on the side of a desolate stretch of roadway. When the police arrive, they pull severely burned human remains from the driver's seat.

724209.description: A retired military officer is found dead in his own backyard during a freak ice storm in San Antonio, Texas.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

724209.description: Manny Alvarez mysteriously crashes his car into a fence. He dies en route to the hospital, leaving behind a wife and son. It is up to Dr. G to find out what cut this young man's life short.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A diabetic man dies after a night out. Meanwhile, an elderly man's decomposing body is found in his son's home. Dr. G realizes that finding the causes of death will be anything but straight-forward.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

724209.description: Amanda Reese breaks out in hives and begins to hyperventilate after returning from a Hurricane Katrina relief effort. Dr. G wonders if an infection caused this young woman's untimely death.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A train passenger behaves oddly en route to Arizona and then disappears. The next day his bloodied body is found in Texas. Dr. G attempts to piece together this bizarre tragedy.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Dr. G must figure out if a decomposed body is that of a local missing woman and if she was murdered.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: During her career as a medical examiner, Dr. G has autopsied thousands of murder victims. In this episode, Dr. G shares her most memorable case.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Dr. G reviews a woman's medical records and learns that that she suffered from an auto-immune disease called lupus, which might have something to do with her death.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A cabdriver develops chest pains and seizures; a hotel manager is found dead on the steps of his apartment.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: When Dr. G receives Lea Conrad's body, she suspects the woman may have died from an antihistamine overdose. Then, Dr. G learns that Lea was being treated for lupus.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: An elderly woman is driving when she's overcome with shooting pains and crashes her car. She's rushed to the hospital, but the doctors find nothing wrong. Can Dr. G find the cause of death?

673498.title: The Violent Men

Robinson), the scheming businessman interested in his property, make Parrish reconsider the move, especially after one of his ranch hands is murdered. Adding to the increasingly tense conflict is Wilkison's wife, Martha (Barbara Stanwyck), who is cheating on her husband with his brother, Cole (Brian Keith).
