673498.title: The Last Frontier
673498.description: Jed Cooper (Victor Mature), a trapper, enlists as an army fort scout, and shortly after meets and falls for Corinna Marston (Anne Bancroft), the wife of a nearby fort's commander. Jed comes across her husband, Col. Marston (Robert Preston), after he's suffered an attack at the hands of Native Americans. Col. Marston forces the captain of Jed's fort, Glenn Riordan (Guy Madison), to send out Jed and the troops to fight his attackers, despite their lack of battle experience.

673498.title: 7th Cavalry
673498.description: Returning to Fort Lincoln, Capt. Benson learns of Custer's defeat at the Little Big Horn. At the inquiry as Custer's officers blame Custer for the defeat, Benson tries to defend him. However, Benson was suspiciously absent at the time of the battle and is now despised by the troops. So when an order to retrieve the bodies from the battlefield arrives, Benson volunteers for the dangerous mission of returning back into Indian territory.

Tonight is also the night we meet Buffman, a pint sized Superhero with a twitch and a photo finish at the Dizzy Dummy threatens extinction to a Rare Breed. A week of action packed Wipeouts with Latin Dancing lotharios, what more can you ask for? And for the kids, a Fairy Tale, Wipeout Style!

Although there is one man who came prepared, Dodgeball Champion Dan Bennett, whose “Duck, Dive, Dip, Dodge and Dunk” training comes into play.

692090.description: A Vietnam vet, reeling from a divorce and the disappearance of his son, tries to write a novel about his war experiences in his haunted boyhood home.

692090.title: Prom Night
692090.description: Six years after a tragic accident, a masked killer hunts the teens responsible, turning their high school prom into a night of terror.

692090.title: Alligator
692090.description: After it’s flushed down the toilet, a baby alligator grows to monstrous size as it prowls the city sewers. Chaos erupts when it comes to the surface.

692090.title: The Exorcist III
692090.description: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

692090.title: Chopping Mall
692090.description: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

692090.title: The Vault
692090.description: Forced by desperate circumstances, two sisters rob a bank and are given instructions to check an old vault, where something dark resides.

692090.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: A Bucket of Blood
692090.description: The Mistress of the Dark presents this 1959 Roger Corman flick about a busboy’s bloody brush with sculpture while trying her own hand at the arts.

692090.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
692090.description: The Mistress of the Dark gets ready for her first game show foray while hosting this 1962 flick about a mad scientist and his decapitated fiancée.

692090.title: Shark Attack 3: Megalodon
692090.description: Marine researchers discover a colossal shark tooth off the Mexican coast and realize the most menacing beast that ever ruled the ocean is still alive.

692090.title: Charlie's Farm
692090.description: Ignoring warnings, four friends head into the Australian outback to visit the site where a violent family met their end at the hands of an angry mob.

692090.title: Spiders 2
692090.description: Rescued from a shipwreck, a couple soon falls prey to a deranged doctor who wants to use them as incubators for a giant spider's eggs.

692090.title: Hush: Shush Cut
692090.description: A deaf woman is stalked by a killer in her home.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas takes in an orphaned teen being raised by his abusive uncle after there is trouble at the school.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The McCains try to be tolerant of their embittered neighbor Abel MacDonald, but they decide he's gone too far when he won't allow his injured boy to get medical treatment.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: An unfounded rumor causes North Fork's outspoken feminist schoolteacher to be attacked by a mob of angry townspeople.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When his employer begins to suspect him of embezzlement, bookkeeper Asa Manning decides to hire a professional gunman to take care of the problem.

724210.description: A drought has forced local cowhands to seek work on a railroad construction project, but executives are afraid workers will desert them if they believe an old man's claim of making rain.

724210.description: Lucas McCain gives blood to save a dying man and is surprised by Marshall Torrance's odd behavior towards him. Soon, men arrive from a nearby town and demand custody of the man.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When Mark finds of the body of a murder victim, Lucas, his friend Artemus and Marshall Torrance begin a search for the killer.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When renegade Apaches wound Lucas and kidnap Mark, Marshall Torrance joins with U.S. Marshall Sam Buckhart to form a rescue posse.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas is the town's representative to the railroad commission until an infamous train robber dies and leaves his ill-gotten wealth to Lucas. Lucas must clear his name.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When a rancher dies after the bank forecloses the mortgage on his property, his son blames the banker for his father's death.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When a wealthy rancher is killed, Mark suggests that they seek the aid of a mind reader to identify the murderer.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A group of outlaws devise a plan to get rid of Lucas so that they can take over the town of North Fork.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: After Lucas kills a mountain man in a brawl, his father arrives in North Fork to break his other boys out of jail and take revenge on Lucas and Marshall Torrance.

724210.description: Newly arrived gunslinger Al Walker throws a mammoth party at the saloon, keeping acting Marshall Ben Waller busy until Lucas is forced to intervene.

724210.description: After Lucas accuses a newspaper writer's misleading articles of causing an innocent man's death, the writer begins writing articles about Lucas.

724210.description: Gavin and Ezra Martin think that Lucas killed their son Clemmie while taking part in a train robbery and Lucas refuses to tell them what really happened.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Eddie's daughter causes trouble for Lucas when two strangers threaten her life after she arrives with criminal information and stolen money.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Town character Brett Conway blackmails Lucas with the knowledge that a young couple Lucas rescued is suffering from yellow fever.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas and Mark arae stranded in the middle of a desert with very little food or water, and after Lucas is injured, Mark becomes the only hope for their survival.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog's target today seems to have a taste for drugs and a record of reckless driving. The hunt has deep emotional resonance for the team because today is the anniversary of the fatal car accident of Dog's daughter Barbara Katie.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog and Beth take time from their busy schedule to thank their fans by inviting them into their home to celebrate the holiday season. But when Dog decides he needs to help his son Garry believe in Santa Claus again the plan changes.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: There is a running joke in the posse that every time Bobby Brown asks them for help with a fugitive he always promises them that it's "an easy one," but the hunts end up being epic searches.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog believes in safety first, and today's hunt puts this philosophy to the test. The fugitive's problem with anger management increases the dangers of their already risky line of work. Dog warns the crew to be ready for anything as they head out.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog doesn't know it yet, but today's bounty is about to take him on a trip down memory lane and test his investigative chops. With each lead propelling him closer and closer to his childhood haunts, Dog uses old-fashioned detective skills.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog is a big-hearted guy and today he's proving it. He's helping Mary Ellen, his friend and fellow bondsman, on a dangerous night hunt for a fugitive she is now regretting bailing out.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Things are seldom what they seem in the world of bounty hunting and it is through this maze of illusions that Dog pursues his prey.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Big Build

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Playing Pretend

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Shopping
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket. George sits in the trolley, while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list. Daddy Pig picks up something not on the list. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - My Birthday Party
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's Peppa Pig's birthday today. She wakes up very early so that none of her special day is wasted. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks, and makes a birthday cake appear. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Traffic Jam

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Father Christmas

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Biggest Muddy Puddle In The World

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Bedtime
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George have one more game of jumping up and down in muddy puddles before bedtime. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Rebecca Rabbit
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George visit Rebecca Rabbit's house today. Rebecca's house is a bit different to Peppa's house - it is inside a hill! And instead of stairs and corridors, there are tunnels. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Boat Pond

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Fish Pond

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cleaning the Car

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Pedro's Cough

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Freddy Fox

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Bull's New Road

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Teddy's Day Out

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Baby Piggy
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George meet their new cousin, a tiny baby piggy called Alexander. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cold Winter's Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is a very cold winter day. Peppa and George are wearing their hats, scarves, mittens and coats. They want to jump in muddy puddles, but the puddles are all frozen and slippery. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mirrors
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George has fun looking at himself in the mirror and tries to find other shiny things. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - New Shoes
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never, ever wants to take them off - until it's time to jump in muddy puddles. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Gardening
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Granny Pig's Chickens
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her chickens, whilst something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit's Lighthouse
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse. Grampy Rabbit knows all about the sea, and can make a lot of noise too, which is useful. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Rainy Day Game
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is raining outside so Peppa and George have to stay indoors. While they wait for the rain to stop, Daddy Pig teaches them a fun game. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Daddy Pig's Office
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's all play and not much work when Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Made Up Musical Instruments
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle gets the playgroup to play music - with instruments that they must make themselves. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Playing Golf
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful minigolf course next door. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Lots of Muddy Puddles
nickjrtoo.uk.description: On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Being Babies
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Dr Hamster's Ant Farm
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Dr Hamster is visiting the playgroup today and has brought a giant ant farm. But nobody notices when they escape and start moving things in the classroom. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Granny Sheep Moves In
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is playing at Suzy's house and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in! She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit's Jetpack
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grampy Rabbit's new jet pack shoots off into the distance and he ends up on top of a snowy mountain. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mountain Climbing
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends learn about climbing from Grampy Rabbit at the climbing centre. Mummy Pig is worried about George when he gets scared of heights. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Funny Music

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cushion Den
nickjrtoo.uk.description: On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Adventure Caravan
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure and the first stop is The Biggest Potato in the World. When it starts to get foggy, they park up before another busy day. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Clubhouse Takeaway

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Walkie Talkies

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Fire Station Practice

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - World Book Day

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Indoor Adventure

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Chloe's Birthday Party

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Being Inspired

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Trampolines

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Please and Thank You

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Lucky Hamper

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Folk Music Band

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - School Camp

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Gerald Giraffe

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Digger World

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mister Skinnylegs

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Delphine Donkey

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa Pig's Computer

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Edmond Elephant's Birthday

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Rock Pools
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George learn there's lots of fun to be had at the beach, even when there's no sand. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Ambulance
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Dr. Brown Bear comes to visit the playgroup and teach all of the children what to do when there's been an accident. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Spider Web

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit in Space
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grampy Rabbit visits Peppa's playgroup to talk about space rockets. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Ballet Lesson

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr Dinosaur is Lost

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - George's Birthday
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George has the best birthday ever, including a visit to the Dinosaur Museum. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Champion Daddy Pig

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Emily Elephant
